cards.ask: Does this count as her yes?
source: فسكتت أو ضحكت أو بكت فذلك إذن منها وإن أبت لم يزوجها
فلا بد من رضاها بالقول
cards.why: For a bikr, silence, laughing or crying is a yes, and a refusal is a no. A thayyib must say it in words.

cards.ask: Which of these is true in al-Quduri's text?
options: A wali may not force an adult bikr to marry
A thayyib's silence is her consent
A woman who says she refused must swear an oath
source: ولا يجوز للولي إجبار البكر البالغة على النكاح
فلا بد من رضاها بالقول
فالقول قولها ولا يمين عليها
cards.why: The wali cannot force an adult bikr. A thayyib must speak, and the woman who says she refused swears no oath.

cards.title: A child's nikah and the wali
cards.ar: ويجوز نكاح الصغير إذا زوجهما الولي بكرا كانت الصغيرة أو ثيبا والولي هو العصبة
cards.en: A wali may contract the nikah of a young boy or girl. The wali is the 'asaba: the male relatives on the father's side, such as the father, grandfather, brother and uncle.

cards.title: A choice on coming of age
cards.ar: فإن زوجهما الأب أو الجد فلا خيار لهما بعد بلوغهما وإن زوجهما غير الأب والجد فلكل واحد منهما الخيار إذا بلغ إن شاء أقام على النكاح وإن شاء فسخ
cards.en: If the father or grandfather arranged it, the two have no choice once they come of age. If anyone else arranged it, each of them has a choice on coming of age: to stay in the nikah or to end it.

cards.ask: When Hind was young, her uncle arranged her nikah. She has now come of age. What may she do?
options: Choose to stay in the nikah or end it
Nothing: the nikah her uncle made binds her
Only her father may now decide
cards.source: وإن زوجهما غير الأب والجد فلكل واحد منهما الخيار إذا بلغ
cards.why: An uncle is not the father or grandfather, so Hind has the choice on coming of age.

cards.title: Who cannot be a wali
cards.ar: ولا ولاية لعبد ولا صغير ولا مجنون ولا كافر على مسلمة وقال أبو حنيفة: يجوز لغير العصبات من الأقارب التزويج
cards.en: Four cannot be a wali: 1) a slave, 2) a child, 3) an insane person, 4) a non-Muslim, over a Muslim woman. Abu Hanifa said relatives who are not 'asaba may also arrange a nikah.

cards.ask: Who cannot be the wali of a Muslim woman?

options.text: A child
An insane person
A non-Muslim relative
A slave
Her adult Muslim brother

cards.source: ولا ولاية لعبد ولا صغير ولا مجنون ولا كافر على مسلمة
cards.why: A slave, a child, an insane person and a non-Muslim have no guardianship over a Muslim woman. Her adult Muslim brother is 'asaba.

cards.title: When the nearer wali is far away
cards.ar: ومن لا ولي لها إذا زوجها مولاها الذي أعتقها جاز وإذا غاب الولي الأقرب غيبة جاز لمن هو أبعد منه أن يزوج والغيبة المنقطعة: أن يكون في بلد لا تصل إليه القوافل في السنة إلا مرة واحدة
cards.en: A woman with no wali may be married off by the one who freed her. If the nearer wali is far away, the next wali may arrange the nikah. "Far away" means in a land the caravans reach only once a year.

cards.ask: What is "far away"? Complete it.
cards.ar: أن يكون في بلد لا تصل إليه ____ في السنة إلا مرة واحدة
cards.source: أن يكون في بلد لا تصل إليه القوافل في السنة إلا مرة واحدة
cards.why: القوافل: a land the caravans reach only once a year.

cards.ask: Maryam's father lives in a far land that caravans reach only once a year. Her brother is at home. Who may arrange her nikah?
options: Her brother, as the next wali
No one until her father returns
source: وإذا غاب الولي الأقرب غيبة جاز لمن هو أبعد منه أن يزوج
لا تصل إليه القوافل في السنة إلا مرة واحدة
cards.why: The nearer wali is far away by the book's measure, so the next wali, her brother, may arrange it.

cards.title: An insane woman's father and son
cards.ar: وإذا اجمع في المجنونة أبوها وابنها فالولي في نكاحها ابنها عند أبي حنيفة وأبي يوسف وقال محمد: أبوها
cards.en: If an insane woman has both a father and a son, her wali for nikah is her son, for Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf. Note: Muhammad says her father.

cards.title: A wali marrying her himself
cards.ar: ويجوز لابن العم أن يزوج بنت عمه من نفسه وإذا أذنت المرأة لرجل أن يزوجها من نفسه فقعد بحضرة شاهدين جاز
cards.en: A cousin who is her wali may marry his uncle's daughter to himself. And if a woman permits a man to marry her to himself, and he makes the contract before two witnesses, it is valid.

cards.ask: Salma's wali is her cousin Idris, and they wish to marry. With her consent, Idris makes the nikah himself before two witnesses. Is it valid?
options: Yes: a cousin may marry her to himself
No: someone else must be her wali
No: a wali can never marry the woman he is wali for
cards.source: ويجوز لابن العم أن يزوج بنت عمه من نفسه
cards.why: The book allows the cousin to marry his uncle's daughter to himself, before two witnesses.

cards.ask: Bashir's father arranged his nikah when Bashir was young. Now he is an adult. Does he have a choice to end it?
options: Yes: every child has the choice
Yes, if he asks within a year
cards.source: فإن زوجهما الأب أو الجد فلا خيار لهما بعد بلوغهما
cards.why: When the father or grandfather arranged it, there is no choice on coming of age.

cards.title: Kafa'a matters
cards.ar: والكفاءة في النكاح معتبرة فإذا تزوجت المرأة غير كفء فللأولياء أن يفرقوا بينهما
cards.en: Kafa'a means the husband being a suitable match (kufu) for the wife. It is taken into account: if a woman marries a man who is not her match, her walis may have them separated.

cards.title: In what kafa'a is measured
cards.ar: والكفاءة تعتبر في النسب والدين والمال وهو: أن يكون مالكا للمهر والنفقة وتعتبر في الصنائع
cards.en: Kafa'a is measured in four things: 1) lineage (nasab), 2) religion, 3) wealth: he can pay the mahr and the nafaqa, 4) trade (work). The mahr is the gift a husband must give his wife; the nafaqa is her upkeep.

cards.ask: In how many things is kafa'a measured?
source: والكفاءة تعتبر في النسب
والمال وهو: أن يكون مالكا للمهر والنفقة وتعتبر في الصنائع
cards.why: Four: lineage, religion, wealth and trade.

cards.ask: Complete it.
cards.ar: والكفاءة تعتبر في ____
cards.source: والكفاءة تعتبر في النسب
cards.why: النسب: lineage is the first thing al-Quduri names.

cards.ask: Which of these does kafa'a look at?

options.text: Lineage
Religion
Being able to pay the mahr and upkeep
Trade or work
Height
Which city he lives in

source: والكفاءة تعتبر في النسب والدين والمال
أن يكون مالكا للمهر والنفقة وتعتبر في الصنائع
cards.why: Lineage, religion, wealth (mahr and nafaqa) and trade. Height and city are not named.

cards.ask: Zayd proposes to Ruqayya, but he has no means to pay a mahr or provide her upkeep. In wealth, is he a kufu for her?
options: No, he is not a kufu in wealth
Yes: wealth does not matter in kafa'a
Yes, if he has a trade
cards.source: والمال وهو: أن يكون مالكا للمهر والنفقة
cards.why: Al-Quduri defines wealth in kafa'a as owning enough for the mahr and nafaqa.

cards.ask: An adult woman marries a man who is not a kufu for her. What may her walis do?
options: Cancel it only if she was a bikr
cards.source: فإذا تزوجت المرأة غير كفء فللأولياء أن يفرقوا بينهما
cards.why: The walis may have them separated when the husband is not her match.

cards.title: A mahr below her worth
cards.ar: وإذا تزوجت المرأة ونقصت من مهرها فللأولياء الاعتراض عليها عند أبي حنيفة حتى يتم لها مهر مثلها أو يفارقها
cards.en: If a woman marries for less than her proper mahr, her walis may object, for Abu Hanifa, until the husband completes her mahr al-mithl or parts from her. Mahr al-mithl is the usual mahr of women like her in her family.

cards.ask: Asma marries for a mahr far below what the women of her family receive. Her walis object. What ends their objection?
options: He pays her full mahr al-mithl, or they part
Asma swearing an oath that she agreed to it
The walis paying the rest of the mahr themselves
cards.source: حتى يتم لها مهر مثلها أو يفارقها
cards.why: The walis may object until he completes her mahr al-mithl or parts from her.

cards.title: Only a father or grandfather
cards.ar: ونقص من مهرها أو ابنه الصغير وزاد في مهر جاز ذلك عليهما ولا يجوز ذلك لغير الأب والجد
cards.en: If a father marries off his young daughter for less than her proper mahr, or his young son for more, it holds against them. No one but the father or grandfather may do this.

cards.ask: An uncle arranges his young niece's nikah for a mahr well below her mahr al-mithl. Does the lower mahr hold?
options: No: only a father or grandfather may do this
Yes: any wali may lower his young ward's mahr
Yes, if two witnesses are present
cards.source: ولا يجوز ذلك لغير الأب والجد
cards.why: Only the father or grandfather may lower a young daughter's mahr.

cards.ask: Which of these is NOT one of the things kafa'a looks at?
cards.source: والكفاءة تعتبر في النسب والدين والمال
cards.why: Lineage, religion, wealth and trade are named. Beauty is not part of kafa'a.

cards.title: Named or not
cards.ar: ويصح النكاح إذا سمى فيه مهرا ويصح وإن لم يسم فيه مهرا
cards.en: The nikah is valid whether or not a mahr is named in it. The mahr is the gift the husband must give his wife.

cards.title: The least mahr
cards.ar: وأقل المهر عشرة دراهم فإن سمى أقل من عشرة فلها العشرة
cards.en: The least mahr is ten dirhams (silver coins). If less than ten is named, she gets ten.

cards.ask: Complete it.
cards.ar: وأقل المهر ____ دراهم
cards.source: وأقل المهر عشرة دراهم
cards.why: عشرة: the least mahr is ten dirhams.

cards.ask: Hamid names a mahr of 6 dirhams for Zaynab. What is she owed?
cards.source: فإن سمى أقل من عشرة فلها العشرة
cards.why: Below ten, she is owed the ten.

cards.title: Full or half
cards.ar: ومن سمى مهرا عشرة فما زاد فعليه المسمى إن دخل بها أو مات عنها وإن طلقها قبل الدخول والخلوة فلها نصف المسمى
cards.en: If he named ten or more, he owes all of it once the marriage is consummated (dukhul) or if he dies. If he divorces her before dukhul and before khalwa (being alone together in private), she gets half of what was named.

cards.ask: Yasin named a mahr of 1,000 dirhams, then divorced Huda before they had ever been alone together. What does she get?
cards.source: وإن طلقها قبل الدخول والخلوة فلها نصف المسمى
cards.why: Divorce before dukhul and khalwa gives her half the named mahr: 500.

cards.title: When no mahr was named
cards.ar: وإن تزوجها ولم يسم لها مهرا أو تزوجها على أن لا مهر لها فلها مهر مثلها إن دخل بها أو مات عنها وإن طلقها قبل الدخول فلها المتعة وهي ثلاثة أثواب من كسوة مثلها
cards.en: If no mahr was named, or they even agreed there would be none, she gets her mahr al-mithl (the usual mahr of women like her) after dukhul or if he dies. If he divorces her before dukhul she gets the mut'a: a parting gift of three garments, the kind of clothes a woman like her wears.

cards.ask: Ibrahim married Sumayya without naming a mahr, then divorced her before dukhul. What is she owed?
cards.source: وإن طلقها قبل الدخول فلها المتعة وهي ثلاثة أثواب من كسوة مثلها
cards.why: With no mahr named and a divorce before dukhul, she is owed the mut'a of three garments.

cards.title: A forbidden thing as mahr
cards.ar: وإن تزوج المسلم على خمر أو خنزير فالنكاح جائز ولها مهر مثلها
cards.en: If a Muslim names wine or pork as the mahr, the nikah is still valid and she gets her mahr al-mithl.

cards.title: A mahr agreed after the nikah
cards.ar: ثم تراضيا على تسمية مهر فهو لها إن دخل بها أو مات عنها وإن طلقها قبل الدخول لها المتعة
cards.en: If no mahr was named and they later agree on one, it is hers after dukhul or if he dies. If he divorces her before dukhul, she gets the mut'a.

cards.ask: What is she owed?
items: 1,000 named, divorced before dukhul and khalwa
Wine named as mahr, after dukhul
source: فعليه المسمى إن دخل بها أو مات عنها وإن طلقها قبل الدخول والخلوة فلها نصف المسمى
فلها مهر مثلها إن دخل بها أو مات عنها
فالنكاح جائز ولها مهر مثلها
cards.why: A named mahr is owed in full after dukhul or death, half if divorced before. With none named, or a forbidden one, she gets mahr al-mithl.

cards.ask: A mahr of 4 dirhams is named, and the husband divorces before dukhul and khalwa. What is she owed?
source: فإن سمى أقل من عشرة فلها العشرة
فلها نصف المسمى
cards.why: Less than ten counts as ten, and divorce before dukhul gives half: 5 dirhams.

cards.title: Adding to or lowering the mahr
cards.ar: وإن زادها في المهر بعد العقد لزمته الزيادة وتسقط بالطلاق قبل الدخول وإن حطت عنه من مهرها صح الحط
cards.en: If the husband adds to the mahr after the contract, he owes the extra, but it falls away if he divorces her before dukhul. If the wife lets him off part of her mahr, that is valid.

cards.ask: Musa named 1,000 dirhams, later added 200 as a kindness, then divorced his wife before dukhul. What does she get?
source: لزمته الزيادة وتسقط بالطلاق قبل الدخول
فلها نصف المسمى
cards.why: The added 200 drops with divorce before dukhul, so she gets half of 1,000.

cards.ask: Layla's mahr is 2,000 dirhams. She tells her husband she lets him off 500 of it. Does this count?
options: Yes: her lowering it is valid
No: the mahr can never be lowered
cards.source: وإن حطت عنه من مهرها صح الحط
cards.why: A wife may let her husband off part of her mahr, and it holds.

cards.title: A valid khalwa
cards.ar: وإذا خلا الزوج بامرأته
cards.en: Khalwa is husband and wife being alone together in private. If they were alone with nothing preventing them from being together as a married couple, and then he divorces her, she gets the full mahr.

cards.title: When khalwa does not count
cards.ar: وإن كان أحدهما مريضا أو صائما في رمضان أو محرما بفرض أو نفل بحج أو عمرة أو كانت حائضا فليست بخلوة صحيحة
cards.en: Four things stop a khalwa being valid: 1) one of them is ill, 2) one is fasting in Ramadan, 3) one is in ihram for Hajj or Umrah, fard or voluntary, 4) she is in her monthly period (hayd).

cards.ask: Which of these stop a khalwa from counting?

options.text: One of them is ill
One of them is fasting in Ramadan
One of them is in ihram for Umrah
She is in her monthly period
He is majbub (unable to be with her)

source: وإن كان أحدهما مريضا أو صائما في رمضان أو محرما بفرض أو نفل بحج أو عمرة أو كانت حائضا فليست بخلوة صحيحة
وإذا خلا المجبوب بامرأته ثم طلقها فلها كمال المهر
cards.why: Illness, the Ramadan fast, ihram and her period are the four. A majbub husband's khalwa still gives her the full mahr.

cards.ask: Anas and his wife were alone at home, both well and with nothing in the way. Later he divorced her before dukhul. The mahr named was 800. What does she get?
cards.source: مانع من الوطء ثم طلقها فلها كمال المهر
cards.why: A valid khalwa followed by divorce gives her the full mahr.

cards.ask: Hasan and his wife were alone during a Ramadan day while he was fasting. Later he divorced her before dukhul. Was that a valid khalwa?
options: No: fasting in Ramadan stops it
Yes: being alone in private is enough
Yes, if it was after Asr
cards.source: أو صائما في رمضان
cards.why: Being in the Ramadan fast is one of the things that make it not a valid khalwa.

cards.title: A husband unable to be with her
cards.ar: وإذا خلا المجبوب بامرأته ثم طلقها فلها كمال المهر عند أبي حنيفة
cards.en: If a husband who is physically unable to be with his wife (majbub) is alone with her and then divorces her, she gets the full mahr, for Abu Hanifa.

cards.title: The parting gift is recommended
cards.ar: وتستحب المتعة لكل مطلقة إلا لمطلقة واحدة وهي: التي طلقها قبل الدخول ولم يسم لها مهرا
cards.en: The mut'a (parting gift) is recommended (mustahabb) for every divorced woman except one: the one divorced before dukhul with no mahr named. For her, as the last lesson taught, the mut'a is what she is owed.

cards.ask: Nusayba was divorced after years of marriage and was paid her full mahr. Is giving her a parting gift recommended?
options: Yes, it is recommended for her
No: she already has her mahr
It is owed to her as a debt, like the mahr
cards.source: وتستحب المتعة لكل مطلقة
cards.why: Only the woman divorced before dukhul with no mahr named is left out; for Nusayba it is recommended.

cards.ask: Which statement matches al-Quduri?
options: A wife may lower her own mahr
An added mahr stays even after divorce before dukhul
A khalwa while she is in her period is valid
source: وإن حطت عنه من مهرها صح الحط
وتسقط بالطلاق قبل الدخول
أو كانت حائضا فليست بخلوة صحيحة
cards.why: Her lowering is valid. The added part falls away, and a khalwa in her period is not valid.

lessons.title: Unusual mahrs and conditions
lessons.arabic: وإذا تزوجها على حيوان غير موصوف

cards.title: One nikah as the mahr of the other
cards.ar: على أن يزوجه الرجل أخته أو ابنته ليكون أحد العقدين عوضا عن الآخر فالعقدان جائزان ولكل واحدة منهما مهر مثلها
cards.en: If one man marries his daughter to another on condition that the other marries him his sister or daughter, so that each nikah is the price of the other, both contracts are valid and each woman gets her mahr al-mithl.

cards.ask: Two fathers agree: each one's daughter marries the other's son, and each nikah is the mahr for the other. What happens?
options: Both valid; each gets her mahr al-mithl
Both are valid, and the swap stands as the mahr
cards.source: فالعقدان جائزان ولكل واحدة منهما مهر مثلها
cards.why: Both contracts stand, and each woman is owed her mahr al-mithl.

cards.title: Service or teaching as a mahr
cards.ar: وإن تزوج حر امرأة على خدمته سنة أو على تعليم القرآن فلها مهر مثلها وإن تزوج عبد حرة بإذن مولاه على خدمتها سنة جاز
cards.en: If a free man names as the mahr a year of his service, or teaching her the Qur'an, she gets her mahr al-mithl instead. But if a slave marries a free woman, with his owner's permission, for a year of service to her, that is valid.

cards.ask: Idris, a free man, offers as his mahr to teach Amira the Qur'an. What is she owed?
cards.source: أو على تعليم القرآن فلها مهر مثلها
cards.why: Teaching the Qur'an does not stand as his mahr; she gets her mahr al-mithl.

cards.title: A mahr with a condition
cards.ar: وإذا تزوج امرأة على ألف درهم على أن لا يخرجها من البلد أو على أن لا يتزوج عليها فإن وفى بالشرط فلها المسمى وإن تزوج عليها أو أخرجها من البلد فلها مهر مثلها
cards.en: If he marries her for 1,000 dirhams on condition that he won't take her out of her town, or won't marry another wife, then if he keeps the condition she gets the 1,000. If he marries another or takes her away, she gets her mahr al-mithl.

cards.ask: Rashid married Hana for 1,000 dirhams on condition he would not move her from her town. Later he moved her to another city. What is she owed?
cards.source: وإن تزوج عليها أو أخرجها من البلد فلها مهر مثلها
cards.why: He broke the condition, so she gets her mahr al-mithl instead of the named sum.

cards.title: An animal not described
cards.ar: وإذا تزوجها على حيوان غير موصوف صحت التسمية ولها الوسط منه والزوج مخير: إن شاء أعطاها ذلك وإن شاء أعطاها قيمته
cards.en: If the mahr is an animal that is not described (say, "a horse"), the naming is valid and she gets one of middle quality. The husband may choose to give her the animal or its value.

cards.ask: Which one does she get? Complete it.
cards.ar: صحت التسمية ولها ____ منه
cards.source: صحت التسمية ولها الوسط منه
cards.why: الوسط: one of middle quality.

cards.title: A cloth not described
cards.ar: ولو تزوجها على ثوب غير موصوف فلها مهر مثلها
cards.en: But if the mahr is a cloth that is not described, she gets her mahr al-mithl.

cards.ask: Does the named mahr stand?
items: A free man's year of service
source: صحت التسمية ولها الوسط منه
فإن وفى بالشرط فلها المسمى
ولو تزوجها على ثوب غير موصوف فلها مهر مثلها
على خدمته سنة أو على تعليم القرآن فلها مهر مثلها
cards.why: An undescribed animal and a kept condition stand. An undescribed cloth, a free man's service and Qur'an teaching give her mahr al-mithl.

cards.ask: Uthman names "a camel" as the mahr, without describing it. What may he give?
options: A camel of middle quality, or its value
Only the best camel, not its value
Her mahr al-mithl, since it was not described
cards.source: ولها الوسط منه والزوج مخير: إن شاء أعطاها ذلك وإن شاء أعطاها قيمته
cards.why: The naming is valid: she gets a middle one, and he chooses between the animal and its value.

cards.title: An enslaved person's nikah
cards.ar: ولا يجوز نكاح العبد والأمة إلا بإذن مولاهما وإذا تزوج العبد بإذن مولاه فالمهر دين في رقبته يباع فيه
cards.en: An enslaved man ('abd) or woman (ama) may marry only with the owner's (mawla's) permission. If the man marries with permission, the mahr is a debt on him, and he may be sold to pay it.

cards.title: An ama's home
cards.ar: وإذا زوج المولى أمته فليس عليه أن يبوئها بيت الزوج ولكنها تخدم المولى ويقال للزوج: متى ظفرت بها وطئتها
cards.en: If an owner marries off his ama, he does not have to give her a home with her husband. She keeps serving the owner, and the husband is told he may be with her whenever he can.

cards.ask: Bashir, an 'abd, marries a free woman with his owner's permission. Who owes her mahr?
options: Bashir: it is a debt he may be sold for
His owner, out of the owner's own wealth
No one: an 'abd's wife gets no mahr
cards.source: فالمهر دين في رقبته يباع فيه
cards.why: With permission, the mahr is a debt on the enslaved husband himself, and he may be sold to pay it.

cards.title: Mut'a and fixed-term marriage are void
cards.ar: ونكاح المتعة والنكاح المؤقت باطل
cards.en: Nikah al-mut'a (a "marriage" for enjoyment for a set time) and a nikah for a fixed period are void (batil): they are not a marriage at all.

cards.ask: A man offers a woman a nikah "for one month only". What is it?
options: Void: a fixed-term nikah is batil
Valid, but becomes a normal nikah
cards.source: ونكاح المتعة والنكاح المؤقت باطل
cards.why: A nikah limited to a time is void.

cards.title: Pending until approved
cards.ar: وتزويج العبد والأمة بغير إذن مولاهما موقوف: فإن أجازه المولى جاز وإن رده بطل وكذلك لو زوج امرأة بغير رضاها أو رجلا بغير رضاه
cards.en: A nikah of an enslaved person without the owner's permission is mawquf: on hold. If the owner approves it, it is valid; if he rejects it, it is void. The same is true when someone marries off a woman or a man without their consent.

cards.ask: Hamza is an adult. His uncle arranges a nikah for him without asking him. When Hamza hears, he gladly approves. What is the nikah?
options: Valid: it was pending and he approved it
Void: a nikah made without his consent is batil
Valid only if his father approves
cards.source: وكذلك لو زوج امرأة بغير رضاها أو رجلا بغير رضاه
cards.why: A nikah made without his consent waits on him. His approval makes it valid.

cards.title: A choice when she is freed
cards.ar: وإذا زوج الأمة مولاها ثم أعتقت فلها الخيار حرا كان زوجها أو عبدا وكذلك المكاتبة
cards.en: If an ama's owner married her off and she is later freed, she has a choice to stay or leave, whether her husband is free or enslaved. The same holds for a mukataba (a woman buying her freedom by installments).

cards.title: No choice if she married herself
cards.ar: بغير إذن مولاها ثم أعتقت صح النكاح ولا خيار لها
cards.en: If an ama married without her owner's permission and was then freed, the nikah becomes valid and she has no choice.

cards.ask: An ama was married by her owner to a free man. Later she is set free. Does she have a choice about the marriage?
options: Yes, whether he is free or not
Only if her husband is still a slave
cards.source: ثم أعتقت فلها الخيار حرا كان زوجها أو عبدا
cards.why: Once freed, she has the choice whatever her husband's status.

cards.ask: Valid, void or pending?
items: A nikah for one year only
An adult woman married off without her consent
An 'abd marrying without his owner's permission
An 'abd marrying with his owner's permission
source: ونكاح المتعة والنكاح المؤقت باطل
وتزويج العبد والأمة بغير إذن مولاهما موقوف
وإذا تزوج العبد بإذن مولاه
cards.why: Mut'a and fixed-term are void. Without consent or permission it is pending. With permission it is valid.

cards.ask: Which of these is mawquf (pending) rather than void?
options: A woman married off without her consent
A nikah for a fixed time, such as one year
source: وكذلك لو زوج امرأة بغير رضاها
ونكاح المتعة والنكاح المؤقت باطل
cards.why: Marrying someone off without consent waits on their approval. Mut'a and fixed-term are void.

cards.title: A wali guaranteeing the mahr
cards.ar: وإذا ضمن الولي المهر صح ضمانه وللمرأة الخيار في مطالبة زوجها أو وليها
cards.en: If the wali guarantees the mahr, the guarantee is valid, and the wife may ask either her husband or the wali for it.

cards.ask: Sana's father guaranteed her mahr. The husband has not paid. Whom may Sana ask?
options: Either her husband or her father
Only her husband, as the guarantee is void
cards.source: وللمرأة الخيار في مطالبة زوجها أو وليها
cards.why: The guarantee is valid, so she may claim from either.

cards.title: A defective (fasid) nikah
cards.ar: وإذا فرق القاضي بين الزوجين في النكاح الفاسد قبل الدخول فلا مهر لها وكذلك بعد الخلوة وإن دخل بها فلها مهر مثلها لا يزاد على المسمى وعليها العدة ويثبت نسب ولدها
cards.en: A fasid nikah is one with a defect that spoils it. If the qadi (judge) separates the couple before dukhul, she gets no mahr, and the same after only khalwa. If there was dukhul, she gets her mahr al-mithl, but no more than what was named. She keeps the iddah, and her child's lineage is established.

cards.ask: A qadi separates a couple in a fasid nikah. They had been alone together, but there was no dukhul. What mahr is owed?
cards.source: قبل الدخول فلا مهر لها وكذلك بعد الخلوة
cards.why: In a fasid nikah, khalwa alone gives no mahr.

cards.ask: In a fasid nikah, 500 dirhams was named and there was dukhul. Her mahr al-mithl would be 800. What is she owed?
cards.source: وإن دخل بها فلها مهر مثلها لا يزاد على المسمى
cards.why: She gets her mahr al-mithl, but not more than the named 500.

cards.title: Whose mahr is compared
cards.ar: ومهر مثلها يعتبر بأخواتها وعماتها
cards.en: Her mahr al-mithl is measured by the mahr of her sisters, her father's sisters and her father's brothers' daughters. It is not measured by her mother or her mother's sister if they are not from her father's tribe.

cards.ask: Asiya's mother is from a different tribe than her father. To find Asiya's mahr al-mithl, whose mahr is looked at?
options: Her mother's and her mother's sister's
source: ومهر مثلها يعتبر بأخواتها وعماتها
ولا يعتبر بأمها وخالتها إذا لم يكونا من قبيلتها
cards.why: The women of her father's side are the measure. Her mother and maternal aunt are not, as they are of another tribe.

cards.title: How alike the women must be
cards.ar: ويعتبر في مهر المثل: أن تتساوى المرأتان في السن والجمال والعفة والمال والعقل والدين والبلد والعصر
cards.en: To compare, the two women must be alike in eight things: 1) age, 2) beauty, 3) chastity, 4) wealth, 5) intelligence, 6) religion, 7) town, 8) time.

cards.ask: In what must the two women be alike for mahr al-mithl?

options.text: Age
Religion
Town
Intelligence
Height
Number of brothers

cards.source: أن تتساوى المرأتان في السن والجمال والعفة والمال والعقل والدين والبلد والعصر
cards.why: Age, beauty, chastity, wealth, intelligence, religion, town and era. Height and brothers are not named.

cards.ask: In how many things must the two women be alike for mahr al-mithl?
cards.source: ويعتبر في مهر المثل: أن تتساوى المرأتان في السن والجمال والعفة والمال والعقل والدين والبلد والعصر
cards.why: Eight: age, beauty, chastity, wealth, intelligence, religion, town and time.

cards.ask: Which statement matches al-Quduri?
options: A fasid nikah's child has its lineage fixed
After a fasid nikah with dukhul, she keeps no iddah
A wali's guarantee of the mahr is void
source: وعليها العدة ويثبت نسب ولدها
وإذا ضمن الولي المهر صح ضمانه
cards.why: She keeps the iddah and the child's lineage is established. The wali's guarantee is valid.

cards.title: Marrying an ama
cards.ar: ويجوز تزويج الأمة مسلمة كانت أو كتابية ولا يجوز أن يتزوج أمة على حرة ويجوز الحرة عليها
cards.en: A man may marry an enslaved woman (ama), Muslim or of the People of the Book. But he may not marry an ama while already married to a free woman. He may marry a free woman while married to an ama.

cards.ask: Yasir is married to a free woman. May he now marry an ama as well?
options: No: not an ama on top of a free wife
Yes: a free man may have up to four wives
cards.source: ولا يجوز أن يتزوج أمة على حرة
cards.why: Al-Quduri forbids marrying an ama on top of a free wife.

cards.title: Four, or two
cards.ar: وللحر أن يتزوج أربعا من الحرائر والإماء وليس له أن يتزوج أكثر من ذلك ولا يتزوج العبد أكثر من اثنتين
cards.en: A free man may marry up to four wives, free or not, and no more. An enslaved man may not marry more than two.

cards.ask: How many for an enslaved man? Complete it.
cards.ar: ولا يتزوج العبد أكثر من ____
cards.source: ولا يتزوج العبد أكثر من اثنتين
cards.why: اثنتين: no more than two.

cards.title: Waiting for the iddah
cards.ar: فإن طلق الحر إحدى الأربع طلاقا بائنا لم يجز له أن يتزوج رابعة حتى تنقضي عدتها
cards.en: If a free man gives one of his four wives a ba'in divorce, he may not marry another fourth wife until her iddah is over.

cards.ask: Ibrahim has four wives. He gives one a ba'in divorce, and her iddah has not ended. May he marry another woman now?
options: No: not until her iddah ends
Yes: a ba'in divorce ends the marriage
Yes, if the other wives agree
cards.source: لم يجز له أن يتزوج رابعة حتى تنقضي عدتها
cards.why: He must wait for the divorced wife's iddah to end before taking a new fourth wife.

cards.ask: May he marry now?
items: A free man with three wives
A free man with four wives
An enslaved man with two wives
A free man whose fourth wife is in her iddah after a ba'in divorce
A man married to an ama, marrying a free woman
source: وللحر أن يتزوج أربعا
ولا يتزوج العبد أكثر من اثنتين
حتى تنقضي عدتها
ويجوز الحرة عليها
cards.why: Three wives leaves room for a fourth. Four is the limit for a free man, two for an enslaved man. During the iddah he waits.

cards.ask: Musa, a free man, has three wives. May he marry a fourth?
options: Yes: up to four is allowed
No: three is the limit for a free man
cards.source: وللحر أن يتزوج أربعا من الحرائر والإماء
cards.why: A free man may marry up to four.

cards.ask: Which is allowed?
options: Marrying a free woman while married to an ama
Marrying an ama while married to a free woman
A free man marrying a fifth wife
source: ولا يجوز أن يتزوج أمة على حرة ويجوز الحرة عليها
وليس له أن يتزوج أكثر من ذلك
cards.why: A free woman may be added to an ama, not the other way. More than four is never allowed.

lessons.title: Defects and the right to separate
lessons.arabic: فإن كان عنينا أجله الحاكم حولا

cards.title: A defect gives no choice
cards.ar: وإن كان بالزوجة عيب فلا خيار لزوجها وإذا كان بالزوج جنون أو جذام أو برص فلا خيار للمرأة عند أبي حنيفة وأبي يوسف وقال محمد: لها الخيار
cards.en: If the wife has a defect, the husband has no choice to cancel the nikah. If the husband has insanity, leprosy (judham) or white skin patches (baras), the wife has no choice either, for Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf. Note: Muhammad says she has the choice.

cards.ask: After the nikah, Imran learns his wife has a long-standing illness. May he have the nikah cancelled for it?
options: No: a wife's defect gives him no choice
Yes: any defect gives a choice
Yes, within the first year of the marriage
cards.source: وإن كان بالزوجة عيب فلا خيار لزوجها
cards.why: Al-Quduri says a defect in the wife gives the husband no choice.

cards.title: A husband unable to be intimate
cards.ar: فإن كان عنينا أجله الحاكم حولا فإن وصل إليها وإلا فرق بينهما إن طلبت المرأة ذلك
cards.en: If the husband is 'innin (unable to be intimate with his wife), the judge gives him a hawl: one full year. If he is able in that time, the marriage stays. If not, the judge separates them if the wife asks for it.

cards.ask: How long is he given? Complete it.
cards.ar: فإن كان عنينا أجله الحاكم ____
cards.source: فإن كان عنينا أجله الحاكم حولا
cards.why: حولا: a full year.

cards.title: A final separation
cards.ar: والفرقة تطليقه بائنة ولها كمال المهر إن كان قد خلا بها
cards.en: The separation counts as a ba'in divorce (final), and she gets the full mahr if they had been alone together (khalwa).

cards.ask: Sakina's husband was given a year by the judge and was still unable. She asks for separation, and they had been alone together. What happens?
options: They are separated, with no mahr
source: وإلا فرق بينهما إن طلبت المرأة ذلك
والفرقة تطليقه بائنة ولها كمال المهر إن كان قد خلا بها
cards.why: After the year the judge separates them at her request. It is a ba'in divorce with the full mahr after khalwa.

cards.title: A eunuch is given the year too
cards.ar: والخصي يؤجل كما يؤجل العنين
cards.en: A khasi (a man who has been castrated) is given the same one-year delay as the 'innin.

cards.ask: Does the wife have a way to separate?
items: He is 'innin and the year passed
He is a khasi and the year passed
source: وإلا فرق بينهما إن طلبت المرأة ذلك
والخصي يؤجل كما يؤجل العنين
أو جذام أو برص فلا خيار للمرأة
cards.why: An 'innin or khasi after the year: she may ask. For judham or baras she has no choice, for Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf.

cards.ask: Who decides the year for an 'innin husband?
cards.source: أجله الحاكم حولا
cards.why: The judge sets the year and, if she asks, separates them.

cards.title: The wife becomes Muslim
cards.ar: وزوجها كافر عرض عليه القاضي الإسلام فإن أسلم فهي امرأته وإن أبى عن الإسلام فرق بينهما وكان ذلك طلاقا بائنا عند أبي حنيفة ومحمد: وقال أبو يوسف: هي فرقة بغير طلاق
cards.en: If a wife becomes Muslim and her husband is not, the qadi invites him to Islam. If he accepts, she stays his wife. If he refuses, they are separated, and that counts as a ba'in divorce for Abu Hanifa and Muhammad. Note: Abu Yusuf says it is a separation without divorce.

cards.ask: Hind becomes Muslim; her husband is not. The qadi invites him to Islam, and he accepts. What follows?
options: She stays his wife, as before
They are separated by a ba'in divorce
They must make a new nikah
cards.source: فإن أسلم فهي امرأته
cards.why: If he accepts Islam when the qadi invites him, she stays his wife.

cards.title: The husband becomes Muslim, his wife is Majusi
cards.ar: فإن أسلم الزوج وتحته مجوسية عرض عليها الإسلام فإن أسلمت فهي امرأته وإن أبت فرق القاضي بينهما ولم تكن هذه الفرقة طلاقا
cards.en: If the husband becomes Muslim and his wife is Majusi, she is invited to Islam. If she accepts, she stays his wife. If she refuses, the qadi separates them, and this separation is not a divorce. If there was dukhul she keeps her mahr; if not, she has no mahr.

cards.title: The husband of a kitabiyya
cards.ar: وإذا أسلم زوج الكتابية فهما على نكاحهما
cards.en: If the husband of a Jewish or Christian wife becomes Muslim, their nikah carries on.

cards.ask: Daniel becomes Muslim. His wife Ruth stays Christian. What happens to their marriage?
cards.source: وإذا أسلم زوج الكتابية فهما على نكاحهما
cards.why: A Muslim may be married to a kitabiyya, so their nikah continues.

cards.ask: Kaveh becomes Muslim. His Majusi wife is invited to Islam and declines. There had been no dukhul. What happens?
options: They are separated, with no mahr
They are separated, and she gets half the mahr
source: وإن أبت فرق القاضي بينهما
وإن لم يكن دخل بها فلا مهر لها
cards.why: The qadi separates them, not as a divorce, and with no dukhul she has no mahr.

cards.title: In dar al-harb
cards.ar: وإذا أسلمت المرأة في دار الحرب لم تقع الفرقة عليها حتى تحيض ثلاث حيض فإذا حاضت بانت من زوجها
cards.en: Dar al-harb is a land at war with the Muslims, outside Muslim rule. If a woman becomes Muslim there, the separation does not happen until she has had three monthly periods. When she has, she is parted from her husband.

cards.title: Leaving dar al-harb
cards.ar: وإذا خرج أحد الزوجين إلينا من دار الحرب مسلما وقعت البينونة بينهما
cards.en: If one spouse comes over from dar al-harb to Muslim lands as a Muslim, the marriage ends between them. If both were captured together, it does not end.

cards.ask: Zayd comes over from dar al-harb to Muslim lands as a Muslim. His wife stays behind. What happens to the marriage?
options: It carries on until she follows him
cards.source: وإذا خرج أحد الزوجين إلينا من دار الحرب مسلما وقعت البينونة بينهما
cards.why: When one spouse comes over to Muslim lands as a Muslim, the marriage ends between them.

cards.title: A woman who migrates
cards.ar: وإذا خرجت المرأة إلينا مهاجرة جاز لها أن تتزوج ولا عدة عليها عند أبي حنيفة فإن كانت حاملا لم تتزوج حتى تضع حملها
cards.en: If a woman comes over to Muslim lands as a muhajira (migrant for her faith), she may marry, and for Abu Hanifa she keeps no iddah. But if she is pregnant, she may not marry until she gives birth.

cards.ask: Amina migrated alone to Muslim lands as a Muslim, leaving her husband behind. She is expecting a baby. When may she marry?
cards.source: فإن كانت حاملا لم تتزوج حتى تضع حملها
cards.why: A pregnant muhajira waits until the birth.

cards.ask: Does the marriage carry on?
items: Husband becomes Muslim, wife stays Christian
Wife becomes Muslim, husband accepts Islam
Wife becomes Muslim, husband refuses Islam
Husband becomes Muslim, Majusi wife refuses Islam
source: فهما على نكاحهما
فإن أسلم فهي امرأته وإن أبى عن الإسلام فرق بينهما
وإن أبت فرق القاضي بينهما
وإن سبيا معا لم تقع البينونة
cards.why: A kitabiyya wife, an accepting husband, or capture together: it carries on. A refusal of Islam leads to separation.

cards.ask: Complete it.
cards.ar: وإذا أسلم زوج ____ فهما على نكاحهما
cards.source: وإذا أسلم زوج الكتابية فهما على نكاحهما
cards.why: الكتابية: the wife of the Book may stay married to a Muslim.

cards.ask: A woman becomes Muslim in dar al-harb. When is she parted from her husband?
options: As soon as she becomes Muslim
cards.source: لم تقع الفرقة عليها حتى تحيض ثلاث حيض
cards.why: In dar al-harb, the separation comes after three periods.

lessons.title: Leaving Islam, and the children's religion

cards.title: If a spouse leaves Islam
cards.ar: أحد الزوجين عن الإسلام وقعت الفرقة بينهما بغير طلاق
cards.en: Ridda means leaving Islam, and one who does so is a murtadd. If either spouse leaves Islam, the marriage ends at once, without a divorce.

cards.title: The mahr after ridda
cards.ar: فإن كان الزوج هو المرتد وقد دخل بها فلها كمال المهر وإن كان لم يدخل بها فلها نصف المهر وإن كانت المرأة هي المرتدة فإن كان قبل الدخول فلا مهر لها وإن كانت الردة بعد الدخول فلها المهر وإن ارتدا معا وأسلما فهما على نكاحهما
cards.en: If the husband left Islam: after dukhul she gets the full mahr, before it half. If the wife left Islam: before dukhul she has no mahr, after it she keeps the mahr. If both left together and both returned to Islam, their nikah carries on.

cards.ask: What mahr is owed?
cards.source: فإن كان الزوج هو المرتد وقد دخل بها فلها كمال المهر وإن كان لم يدخل بها فلها نصف المهر وإن كانت المرأة هي المرتدة فإن كان قبل الدخول فلا مهر لها وإن كانت الردة بعد الدخول فلها المهر
cards.why: After dukhul the mahr is hers in full. Before dukhul it is half if he left Islam, and none if she did.

cards.title: No nikah for a murtadd
cards.ar: ولا يجوز أن يتزوج المرتد مسلمة ولا كافرة ولا مرتدة وكذلك المرتدة لا يتزوجها مسلم ولا كافر ولا مرتد
cards.en: A man who has left Islam may not marry a Muslim, a non-Muslim, or another murtadd. Likewise no one may marry a woman who has left Islam.

cards.title: The children's religion
cards.ar: وإذا كان أحد الزوجين مسلما فالولد على دينه وكذلك إن أسلم أحدهما وله ولد صغير صار ولده مسلما بإسلامه وإن كان أحد الأبوين كتابيا والآخر مجوسيا فالولد كتابي
cards.en: If one parent is Muslim, the child follows that parent's religion. So if one parent becomes Muslim and has a young child, the child becomes Muslim too. If one parent is of the Book and the other Majusi, the child counts as of the Book.

cards.ask: Yaqub's father becomes Muslim; his mother does not. Yaqub is six. What is Yaqub's religion in fiqh?
options: He has none until he is grown
cards.source: وكذلك إن أسلم أحدهما وله ولد صغير صار ولده مسلما بإسلامه
cards.why: A young child becomes Muslim with the parent who becomes Muslim.

cards.ask: A child's mother is Christian and the father is Majusi. How is the child counted?
cards.source: وإن كان أحد الأبوين كتابيا والآخر مجوسيا فالولد كتابي
cards.why: With one parent of the Book and one Majusi, the child is counted as kitabi.

cards.title: Marriages made before Islam
cards.ar: وإذا تزوج الكافر بغير شهود أو في عدة الكافر وذلك في دينهم
cards.en: If a non-Muslim couple married without witnesses, or during an iddah from a non-Muslim, and their religion allowed it, then both became Muslim, they are left in that marriage. But if a Majusi had married his mother or daughter and then they became Muslim, they are separated.

cards.ask: Before Islam, Peter and Martha married with no witnesses, as their religion allowed. Now both have become Muslim. What about their marriage?
options: It is left as it is
They must redo the nikah with witnesses
source: وإذا تزوج الكافر بغير شهود
ثم أسلما أقرا عليه
cards.why: Their earlier marriage is accepted once they both become Muslim.

cards.ask: A married couple both leave Islam together and later both return to Islam. What about their nikah?
cards.source: وإن ارتدا معا وأسلما فهما على نكاحهما
cards.why: If they left together and returned together, the book keeps them on their nikah.

cards.title: Being fair
cards.ar: وإذا كان للرجل امرأتان حرتان
cards.en: If a man has two free wives, he must be fair between them in qasm: sharing his nights between them equally.

cards.title: Old or new, the same
cards.ar: بينهما في القسم بكرين كانتا أو ثيبتين أو إحداهما بكرا والأخرى ثيبا
cards.en: This is so whether both were never married before (bikr), both were married before (thayyib), or one of each.

cards.ask: Harun marries Ruqayya (a bikr) while already married to Khadija (a thayyib). How should he share his nights?
cards.source: بينهما في القسم بكرين كانتا أو ثيبتين أو إحداهما بكرا والأخرى ثيبا
cards.why: Bikr or thayyib, the turns are equal.

cards.title: A free wife and an ama
cards.ar: فللحرة الثلثان من القسم وللأمة الثلث
cards.en: If one wife is free and the other an ama, the free wife has two thirds of the turns and the ama one third.

cards.ask: A man's wives are a free woman and an ama. Over 3 nights, how many are the free wife's?
cards.source: فللحرة الثلثان من القسم وللأمة الثلث
cards.why: The free wife has two thirds: 2 of every 3 nights.

cards.title: On a journey
cards.ar: ولا حق لهن في القسم حالة السفر ويسافر الزوج بمن شاء منهن
cards.en: On a journey the wives have no right to turns: the husband may travel with whichever of them he wishes. It is better that he draws lots and travels with the one whose lot comes out.

cards.ask: Zubayr is going on a journey and can take one wife. Which way is best?
options: Take each in turn, by the calendar
source: ويسافر الزوج بمن شاء منهن
فيسافر بمن خرجت قرعتها
cards.why: He may take whom he wishes, but drawing lots is better.

cards.title: Giving up a turn
cards.ar: وإن رضيت الزوجات بترك قسمها لصاحبتها جاز ولها أن ترجع في ذلك
cards.en: If a wife is happy to give her turn to the other wife, that is allowed, and she may take it back later.

cards.ask: Hafsa gave her nights to her co-wife. Months later she wants them back. May she?
options: Yes: she may take it back
No: a gift cannot be undone
cards.source: ولها أن ترجع في ذلك
cards.why: Al-Quduri says she may go back on giving up her turn.

cards.ask: Which statement matches al-Quduri?
options: Wives have no right to turns during a journey
A new bikr wife gets more nights than a thayyib
A free wife and an ama share nights equally
source: ولا حق لهن في القسم حالة السفر
بكرين كانتا أو ثيبتين
فللحرة الثلثان من القسم وللأمة الثلث
cards.why: Turns stop on a journey. Bikr and thayyib are equal, and the free wife has two thirds.

lessons.title: Milk kinship: how long, and who becomes family

cards.title: A little or a lot
cards.ar: قليل الرضاع وكثيره سواء إذا حصل في مدة الرضاع تعلق به التحريم
cards.en: Rada' is a baby being nursed on a woman's milk. A little nursing and a lot are the same: if it happens within the nursing period, it brings tahrim. That means the baby becomes like close family to her (a mahram), and marriage between them is forbidden.

cards.title: The nursing period
cards.ar: ومدة الرضاع عند أبي حنيفة ثلاثون شهرا وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: سنتان فإذا مضت مدة الرضاع لم يتعلق بالرضاع تحريم
cards.en: For Abu Hanifa the nursing period is thirty months. Once it has passed, nursing no longer makes anyone family. Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad say the period is two years.

cards.ask: Little Umar is 20 months old. His mother is ill, and her neighbour Khadija nurses him just once. Does this make milk kinship?
options: Yes: within the period, once is enough
No: one feed is too little
No: he is too old for nursing to count
cards.source: قليل الرضاع وكثيره سواء إذا حصل في مدة الرضاع
cards.why: Yes. Within the nursing period a single feed counts just like many feeds.

cards.ask: A girl who is three years old (36 months) is nursed by a woman. Following Abu Hanifa, does this make milk kinship?
options: No: the thirty-month period has passed
Yes: nursing makes milk kinship at any age
Yes, if she drank a lot
source: ومدة الرضاع عند أبي حنيفة ثلاثون شهرا
فإذا مضت مدة الرضاع لم يتعلق بالرضاع تحريم
cards.why: No. Abu Hanifa's period is thirty months, and nursing after it makes no tahrim.

cards.title: Like family by blood, with exceptions
cards.ar: ويحرم من الرضاع ما يحرم من النسب إلا أم أخته من الرضاع فإنه يجوز أن يتزوجها ولا يجوز أن يتزوج أم أخته من النسب
cards.en: Whoever is forbidden to marry through blood (nasab) is forbidden through milk too. There are exceptions. A man may marry the mother of his milk-sister, though he may never marry the mother of his sister by blood.

cards.title: The milk-son's sister, and in-laws
cards.ar: وأخت ابنه من الرضاع يجوز أن يتزوجها ولا يجوز أخت ابنه من النسب وامرأة ابنه من الرضاع لا يجوز أن يتزوجها
cards.en: He may marry the sister of his milk-son, but not the sister of his son by blood. The wife of his milk-son is forbidden to him, just like his blood son's wife. So is the wife of his milk-father.

cards.ask: Through milk kinship, may a man marry her?
source: ويحرم من الرضاع ما يحرم من النسب إلا أم أخته من الرضاع
وأخت ابنه من الرضاع يجوز أن يتزوجها
وامرأة أبيه من الرضاع لا يجوز أن يتزوجها كما لا يجوز أن يتزوج امرأة أبيه من النسب
cards.why: The mother of his milk-sister and the sister of his milk-son are the exceptions. His milk-mother and the wives of his milk-son and milk-father are forbidden, as by blood.

cards.title: The husband's milk
cards.ar: ولبن الفحل يتعلق به التحريم وهو: أن ترضع المرأة صبية فتحرم هذه الصبية على زوجها وعلى آبائه وأبنائه ويصير الزوج الذي نزل منه اللبن أبا للمرضعة
cards.en: Laban al-fahl, "the husband's milk": a woman's milk comes because of her husband, so he becomes family too. If a woman nurses a baby girl, the girl is forbidden to the woman's husband, his fathers and his sons. The husband becomes her milk-father.

cards.ask: Fatima nursed baby Sara. Years later, the son of Fatima's husband Bilal, from his other wife, wants to marry Sara. May he?
options: No: his father Bilal is her milk-father
Yes: he is not Fatima's son, so he may marry her
Yes, if Sara was nursed only once
cards.source: فتحرم هذه الصبية على زوجها وعلى آبائه وأبنائه
cards.why: No. Through the husband's milk, the girl is forbidden to the husband, his fathers and his sons.

cards.title: Two babies on one breast
cards.ar: وكل صبيين اجتمعا على ثدي واحد لم يجز لأحدهما أن يتزوج بالآخر
cards.en: Any two babies nursed by the same woman may never marry each other. A girl nursed by a woman may not marry any of that woman's children or grandchildren, and a nursed boy may not marry the sister of the nursing woman's husband: she is his milk-aunt.

cards.ask: Hamza and Sami were nursed by the same woman, so they are milk-brothers. Sami has a sister by blood, Layla, whom that woman never nursed. May Hamza marry Layla?
options: Yes: she is his milk-brother's sister
No: all of Sami's family is forbidden to him
cards.source: ويجوز أن يتزوج الرجل بأخت أخيه من الرضاع كما يجوز أن يتزوج بأخت أخيه من النسب
cards.why: Yes. A man may marry his milk-brother's sister, just as a man may marry his half-brother's sister from another mother.

cards.ask: Amina, the wife of Khalid, nursed baby Zayd. Which of these may Zayd never marry?

options.text: Amina's daughter
A girl Amina nursed at the same time as Zayd
Khalid's sister
Amina's son's daughter
The blood sister of Sami, another baby Amina nursed, when Amina never nursed her

source: وكل صبيين اجتمعا على ثدي واحد لم يجز لأحدهما أن يتزوج بالآخر ولا يجوز أن تتزوج المرضعة أحدا من ولد التي أرضعتها ولا ولد ولدها ولا يتزوج الصبي المرضع أخت زوج المرضعة لأنها عمته من الرضاع
ويجوز أن يتزوج الرجل بأخت أخيه من الرضاع
cards.why: Amina's children and grandchildren, any baby she nursed, and her husband's sister (his milk-aunt) are forbidden. His milk-brother's sister by blood is allowed.

cards.title: Milk mixed with water
cards.ar: وإذا اختلط اللبن بالماء واللبن هو الغالب تعلق به التحريم وإن غلب الماء لم يتعلق به التحريم
cards.en: If a woman's milk is mixed with water and the milk is more, it still makes milk kinship. If the water is more, it does not.

cards.title: Food and medicine
cards.ar: وإذا اختلط بالطعام لم يتعلق به التحريم وإن كان اللبن غالبا عند أبي حنيفة وإذا اختلط بالدواء وهو الغالب تعلق به التحريم
cards.en: Milk mixed into food makes no milk kinship, for Abu Hanifa, even if the milk is more. Milk mixed with medicine does make it, when the milk is more.

cards.ask: Does the mixture make milk kinship?
items: Milk with a little water, the milk being more
Water with a little milk, the water being more
Milk cooked into food, even if the milk is more
Milk mixed with medicine, the milk being more
Goat's milk with less of a woman's milk
source: وإذا اختلط اللبن بالماء واللبن هو الغالب تعلق به التحريم وإن غلب الماء لم يتعلق به التحريم
وإذا اختلط بالطعام لم يتعلق به التحريم وإن كان اللبن غالبا
وإذا اختلط بالدواء وهو الغالب تعلق به التحريم
cards.why: What is more decides with water and medicine. Food never makes milk kinship, even when the milk is more.

cards.title: A woman who has died, and goat's milk
cards.ar: وإذا حلب اللبن من المرأة بعد موتها فأوجر به الصبي تعلق به التحريم وإذا اختلط اللبن بلبن شاة واللبن هو الغالب تعلق به التحريم وإن غلب لبن الشاة لم يتعلق به التحريم
cards.en: If milk is taken from a woman after she has died and given to a baby, it makes milk kinship. If her milk is mixed with goat's milk, it counts when her milk is more, and not when the goat's milk is more.

cards.ask: Some of Hind's milk is mixed with more goat's milk, and a baby drinks it. Does it make milk kinship?
options: No: the goat's milk is the greater part
Yes: any woman's milk in it makes kinship
Yes, if the baby drank it twice
cards.source: وإن غلب لبن الشاة لم يتعلق به التحريم
cards.why: When the goat's milk is more, her milk makes no milk kinship.

cards.title: The milk of two women
cards.ar: وإذا اختلط لبن امرأتين تعلق التحريم بأكثرهما عند أبي حنيفة وأبي يوسف وقال محمد: يتعلق بهما
cards.en: If the milk of two women is mixed, the baby becomes the milk-child of the woman whose milk is more, for Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf. Note: Muhammad says the baby becomes the milk-child of both.

cards.title: A virgin's milk, a man's milk, a goat's milk
cards.ar: وإذا نزل للبكر لبن فأرضعت به صبيا تعلق به التحريم وإذا نزل للرجل لبن فأرضع به صبيا لم يتعلق به التحريم
cards.en: If an unmarried girl (bikr) has milk and nurses a baby with it, it makes milk kinship. If a man has milk and gives it to a baby, it does not. And two babies who drink from the same goat do not become milk-siblings.

cards.ask: Which of these make milk kinship?

options.text: Milk of an unmarried girl given to a baby
Milk taken from a woman after she died, given to a baby
Mixed milk of two women: the woman whose milk is more
Milk that came from a man
Two babies drinking the milk of the same goat

source: وإذا نزل للبكر لبن فأرضعت به صبيا تعلق به التحريم وإذا نزل للرجل لبن فأرضع به صبيا لم يتعلق به التحريم
وإذا شرب صبيان من لبن
فلا رضاع بينهما
فأوجر به الصبي تعلق به التحريم
تعلق التحريم بأكثرهما
cards.why: A virgin's milk, a dead woman's milk and the larger share of mixed milk all count. A man's milk and a goat's milk do not.

cards.title: When one wife nurses the other
cards.ar: وإذا تزوج الرجل صغيرة وكبيرة فأرضعت الكبيرة الصغيرة حرمتا على الزوج
cards.en: In al-Quduri's time a guardian could marry off a baby girl. If a man had such a baby wife and a grown wife, and the grown wife nursed the baby, both became forbidden to him: they are now milk-mother and milk-daughter.

cards.ask: Yusuf's grown wife nursed his baby wife. What happens to his two marriages?
options: Both wives become forbidden to him
Only the baby wife is forbidden
Nothing: they are not related by blood
cards.source: فأرضعت الكبيرة الصغيرة حرمتا على الزوج
cards.why: Both wives become forbidden to him, since they are now milk-mother and milk-daughter.

cards.title: The mahr when one wife nursed the other
cards.ar: فإن كان لم يدخل بالكبيرة فلا مهر لها وللصغيرة نصف المهر ويرجع به الزوج على الكبيرة إن كانت تعمدت به الفساد
cards.en: If his marriage with the grown wife had not been consummated, she gets no mahr (the bride-gift), and the little one gets half the mahr. He can claim that half back from the grown wife if she nursed the baby on purpose to break the marriage.

cards.ask: In that case, the older wife nursed the baby only because the baby was hungry and crying, not to break the marriage. Does she owe the husband the half mahr?
options: No: she did not mean to break it
Yes, but only a quarter of the mahr
source: إن كانت تعمدت به الفساد
وإن لم تتعمد فلا شيء عليها
cards.why: No. He can claim it from her only if she meant to break the marriage; if she did not, she owes nothing.

cards.title: Proving nursing
cards.ar: ولا تقبل في الرضاع شهادة النساء منفردات وإنما يثبت بشهادة رجلين أو رجل وامرأتين
cards.en: Women alone cannot prove that nursing took place. It is proven by two men, or one man and two women, as witnesses.

cards.ask: Two women, with no man, testify that Ahmad and his wife were both nursed by the same woman as babies. Is the nursing proven?
options: No: it needs a man among the witnesses
Yes: two women are enough to prove nursing
Yes, if the women are elderly
cards.source: ولا تقبل في الرضاع شهادة النساء منفردات وإنما يثبت بشهادة رجلين أو رجل وامرأتين
cards.why: No. Women on their own are not accepted for nursing; two men, or a man and two women, are needed.

cards.title: Three kinds
cards.ar: الطلاق على ثلاثة أوجه: أحسن الطلاق وطلاق السنة وطلاق البدعة
cards.en: Talaq is divorce: the husband ending the marriage. It comes in three kinds: 1) ahsan, the best way, 2) the Sunna way, 3) bid'a, an innovated, wrong way.

cards.ask: How many kinds of talaq does the book name?
cards.source: الطلاق على ثلاثة أوجه: أحسن الطلاق وطلاق السنة وطلاق البدعة
cards.why: Three: the best way, the Sunna way and the bid'a way.

cards.title: The best way and the Sunna way
cards.ar: في طهر لم يجامعها فيه ويتركها حتى تنقضي عدتها وطلاق السنة: أن يطلق المدخول بها ثلاثا في ثلاثة أطهار
cards.en: The best way: one talaq, given in a tuhr (a clean time between two periods) in which he has not been intimate with her, and then he leaves her until her 'idda (her waiting time after divorce) ends. The Sunna way, for a wife whose marriage was consummated: three talaqs, one in each of three separate tuhrs.

cards.ask: Khalid gives his wife one talaq in a tuhr in which he was not intimate with her, then leaves her until her 'idda ends. Which way is this?
cards.source: في طهر لم يجامعها فيه ويتركها حتى تنقضي عدتها
cards.why: One talaq in a clean tuhr, then leaving her until the 'idda ends, is the best way.

cards.title: The bid'a way
cards.ar: يطلقها ثلاثا بكلمة واحدة أو ثلاثا في طهر واحد فإذا فعل ذلك وقع الطلاق وبانت منه وكان عاصيا
cards.en: The bid'a way: three talaqs in one word, or three in a single tuhr. If he does this, the divorce still happens, she is separated from him, and he has sinned.

cards.ask: Which kind of talaq is this?
items: One talaq in a tuhr without intimacy, then he waits for the 'idda to end
Three talaqs, one in each of three tuhrs
Three talaqs in a single sentence
Three talaqs all in the same tuhr
source: فأحسن الطلاق: أن يطلق الرجل امرأته
في طهر لم يجامعها فيه ويتركها حتى تنقضي عدتها
وطلاق السنة: أن يطلق المدخول بها ثلاثا في ثلاثة أطهار
يطلقها ثلاثا بكلمة واحدة أو ثلاثا في طهر واحد
cards.why: One talaq then waiting is the best way; one in each of three tuhrs is the Sunna way; three at once or in one tuhr is bid'a.

cards.ask: Put the three kinds of talaq in the book's order, from the best
cards.source: الطلاق على ثلاثة أوجه: أحسن الطلاق وطلاق السنة وطلاق البدعة
cards.why: The book names the best way first, then the Sunna way, then the bid'a way.

cards.ask: In anger, Umar tells his wife in one sentence, "You are divorced three times." What happens?
options: It happens, and he has sinned
Nothing happens, because it was the bid'a way
One talaq happens, and he has done nothing wrong
cards.source: فإذا فعل ذلك وقع الطلاق وبانت منه وكان عاصيا
cards.why: A bid'a talaq still happens and separates her, but the husband has sinned by doing it.

cards.title: Sunna in number and in time
cards.ar: سنة في العدد فالسنة في العدد يستوي فيها المدخول بها وغير المدخول بها والسنة في الوقت تثبت في المدخول بها خاصة وهو: أن يطلقها في طهر لم يجامعها فيه وغير المدخول بها يطلقها في حال الطهر والحيض
cards.en: The Sunna has two sides. In number (one at a time), it is the same for every wife. In timing (in a tuhr without intimacy), it applies only to a wife whose marriage was consummated. A wife whose marriage was never consummated may be divorced while clean or during her period.

cards.ask: Hasan made a nikah with Sumayya, but the marriage was never consummated. She is now on her period. Can he give her one talaq the Sunna way now?
options: Yes: timing binds only consummated marriages
No: he must wait until she is clean
No: a talaq before consummation is never Sunna
source: والسنة في الوقت تثبت في المدخول بها خاصة
وغير المدخول بها يطلقها في حال الطهر والحيض
cards.why: Yes. For a wife whose marriage was not consummated, he may divorce her while clean or on her period.

cards.title: A wife who has no periods
cards.ar: وإذا كانت المرأة لا تحيض من صغر أو كبر فأراد أن يطلقها للسنة طلقها واحدة فإذا مضى شهر طلقها أخرى فإذا مضى شهر آخر طلقها آخرى ويجوز أن يطلقها ولا يفصل بين وطئها وطلاقها بزمان
cards.en: If she has no periods because she is too young or too old, months take the place of tuhrs: one talaq, then another after a month, then another after a second month. He may also divorce her straight after intimacy, with no time in between.

cards.ask: With no periods, what comes between the talaqs? Complete it.
cards.ar: فإذا مضى ____ طلقها أخرى
cards.source: طلقها واحدة فإذا مضى شهر طلقها أخرى
cards.why: شهر: for a wife with no periods, a month stands in place of a tuhr.

cards.ask: Zayd's elderly wife no longer has periods. He wants to give three talaqs the Sunna way. How long is it from the first talaq to the third?
options: Two months: one talaq each month
He cannot: a Sunna talaq needs periods
cards.source: طلقها واحدة فإذا مضى شهر طلقها أخرى فإذا مضى شهر آخر طلقها آخرى
cards.why: One talaq, a month, a second, another month, a third: two months from the first to the third.

lessons.title: Pregnancy, periods, and whose divorce counts
lessons.arabic: ويقع طلاق كل زوج إذا كان عاقلا بالغا

cards.title: A pregnant wife
cards.ar: وطلاق الحامل يجوز عقيب الجماع ويطلقها للسنة ثلاثا يفصل بين كل تطليقتين بشهر عند أبي حنيفة وأبي يوسف وقال محمد: لا يطلقها للسنة إلا واحدة
cards.en: A pregnant wife may be divorced right after intimacy. For Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf, the Sunna way with her is three talaqs, with a month between each two. Note: Muhammad says the Sunna way with her is only one talaq.

cards.ask: Yasir's wife is pregnant. Following Abu Hanifa, how does he give three talaqs the Sunna way?
options: One talaq, then a month between each two
One talaq in each of three separate tuhrs
cards.source: ويطلقها للسنة ثلاثا يفصل بين كل تطليقتين بشهر
cards.why: For Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf, a month separates each two talaqs.

cards.title: A divorce during her period
cards.ar: وإذا طلق الرجل امرأته في حال الحيض وقع الطلاق ويستحب له أن يراجعها
cards.en: If a man divorces his wife during her period, the divorce happens. But it is recommended that he take her back (raj'a, returning to the marriage during the 'idda).

cards.title: Then he chooses
cards.ar: فإذا طهرت وحاضت وطهرت فهو مخير: إن شاء طلقها وإن شاء أمسكها
cards.en: Once she has become clean, had another period and become clean again, he may choose: divorce her or keep her.

cards.ask: He divorced her during her period. Put what follows in order.
steps: He takes her back, as is recommended
He may divorce her or keep her
source: ويستحب له أن يراجعها وإن شاء أمسكها
فإذا طهرت وحاضت وطهرت فهو مخير
cards.why: He takes her back, waits for a tuhr, a period and another tuhr, and then chooses.

cards.ask: Bilal divorced his wife while she was on her period. Did the divorce happen?
options: Yes, but he is advised to take her back
No: a divorce during the period does not count
Yes, and he may never take her back
cards.source: وإذا طلق الرجل امرأته في حال الحيض وقع الطلاق ويستحب له أن يراجعها
cards.why: It happens, and it is recommended that he take her back.

cards.title: Whose divorce counts
cards.ar: ويقع طلاق كل زوج إذا كان عاقلا بالغا ولا يقع طلاق الصبي والمجنون والنائم
cards.en: The talaq of every husband who is sane and adult counts. The talaq of a boy, of an insane man, and of a man asleep does not.

cards.title: An enslaved husband
cards.ar: ثم طلق وقع طلاقه ولا يقع طلاق مولاه على امرأته
cards.en: In al-Quduri's time, if an enslaved man married and then divorced his wife, his talaq counted. His master could not divorce the man's wife for him.

cards.ask: Does this talaq count?
items: A married boy, not yet adult
A husband talking in his sleep
In al-Quduri's time, an enslaved husband's own talaq
In al-Quduri's time, a master divorcing his slave's wife
source: ويقع طلاق كل زوج إذا كان عاقلا بالغا ولا يقع طلاق الصبي والمجنون والنائم
ثم طلق وقع طلاقه ولا يقع طلاق مولاه على امرأته
cards.why: A sane adult husband's talaq counts, and an enslaved husband's own talaq counted. A boy, a sleeper and a master divorcing for him do not count.

cards.ask: Hamid says "You are divorced" in his sleep, while his wife is on her period. What happens?
options: Nothing: a sleeper's talaq does not count
It happens, and he is advised to take her back
It happens as a bid'a talaq
cards.source: ولا يقع طلاق الصبي والمجنون والنائم
cards.why: Nothing happens. The talaq of a man asleep does not count, so her period does not matter.

cards.title: Clear and hinted
cards.ar: والطلاق على ضربين: صريح وكناية فالصريح قوله: أنت طالق
cards.en: Talaq is said in two ways: sarih (clear words) and kinaya (hints, words that could mean divorce or something else). The clear words include "You are divorced" (anti taliq).

cards.title: What clear words do
cards.ar: وطلقتك فهذا يقع به الطلاق الرجعي ولا يقع به إلا واحدة وإن نوى أكثر من ذلك ولا يفتقر إلى النية
cards.en: "You are divorced", "divorced woman" and "I have divorced you" give one raj'i (revocable) talaq: he may take her back during the 'idda. Only one happens even if he intended more, and no intention is needed.

cards.ask: Ibrahim says to his wife "You are divorced", intending three. How many talaqs happen?
cards.source: ولا يقع به إلا واحدة وإن نوى أكثر من ذلك
cards.why: One revocable talaq: these clear words give only one, even if he intended more.

cards.title: "You are the divorce"
cards.ar: وقوله: أنت الطلاق أو أنت طالق الطلاق أو أنت طالق طلاقا فإن لم تكن له نية فهي واحدة رجعية وإن نوى به ثلاثا كان ثلاثا
cards.en: If he says "You are the divorce", "You are divorced, the divorce" or "You are divorced with a divorce": with no intention it is one revocable talaq, and if he intended three, it is three.

cards.title: Hints
cards.ar: وهي على ضربين منها ثلاثة ألفاظ بها الطلاق الرجعي ولا يقع بها إلا واحدة وهي قوله: اعتدي واستبرئي رحمك وأنت واحدة
cards.en: Hinted words only cause talaq when he intends it, or the situation shows it. Three of them give one revocable talaq: "Count your 'idda", "Make sure your womb is clear" and "You are one".

cards.ask: How many hinted phrases give a revocable talaq?
cards.source: منها ثلاثة ألفاظ بها الطلاق الرجعي ولا يقع بها إلا واحدة وهي قوله: اعتدي واستبرئي رحمك وأنت واحدة
cards.why: Three: "Count your 'idda", "Make sure your womb is clear" and "You are one".

cards.ask: Which of these hinted phrases give a revocable talaq?

options.text: "Count your 'idda"
"Go to your family"
"Make sure your womb is clear"
"You are one"
"You are forbidden"

source: منها ثلاثة ألفاظ بها الطلاق الرجعي ولا يقع بها إلا واحدة وهي قوله: اعتدي واستبرئي رحمك وأنت واحدة
إذا نوى بها الطلاق كانت واحدة بائنة
cards.why: The three are "Count your 'idda", "Make sure your womb is clear" and "You are one". "Go to your family" and "forbidden" give a final talaq.

cards.ask: Ali says to his wife "Count your 'idda", meaning divorce. What happens?
options: No talaq: it is only a hint
cards.source: منها ثلاثة ألفاظ بها الطلاق الرجعي ولا يقع بها إلا واحدة وهي قوله: اعتدي
cards.why: "Count your 'idda" is one of the three hints that give one revocable talaq when he means divorce.

cards.title: The other hints are final
cards.ar: إذا نوى بها الطلاق كانت واحدة بائنة وإن نوى ثلاثا كانت وإن نوى اثنتين كانت واحدة مثل قوله: أنت بائن وبتة وبتلة وحرام وحبلك على غاربك والحقي بأهلك
cards.en: The other hints, when he intends talaq, give one ba'in (final) talaq: he cannot take her back without a new nikah. If he intended three it is three; if he intended two it is one. Examples: "You are separated", "cut off", "forbidden", "Your rope is on your back", "Go to your family".

cards.ask: He means one divorce. Is this talaq revocable or final?
source: والضرب الثاني: والكنايات ولا يقع بها الطلاق إلا
فهذا يقع به الطلاق الرجعي
وهي قوله: اعتدي واستبرئي رحمك وأنت واحدة
إذا نوى بها الطلاق كانت واحدة بائنة
cards.why: The clear words and the three hints give a revocable talaq; the other hints give a final one.

cards.title: No intention
cards.ar: فإن لم يكن له نية لم يقع بهذه الألفاظ طلاق إلا أن يكونا في مذاكرة الطلاق فيقع بها الطلاق في القضاء ولايقع فيما بينه وبين الله تعالى إلا أن ينويه
cards.en: With no intention, these hints cause no talaq, unless the couple were talking about divorce. Then a judge counts it as talaq, but between him and Allah it does not count unless he meant it. In anger or a quarrel, every hint counts except words meant as an insult.

cards.ask: In the middle of a quarrel, Tariq tells his wife "Go to your family!" He says he did not mean divorce. What does the judge rule?
options: Talaq happens, as it is no insult
Nothing happens, because he did not mean it
source: وإن لم يكونا في مذاكرة الطلاق وكانا في غضب أو خصومة وقع الطلاق بكل لفظ لا يقصد به السب والشتيمة ولم يقع بما يقصد به السب
cards.why: In a quarrel, talaq happens with every hinted word that is not an insult, and "Go to your family" is not one.

cards.title: Making the talaq strong
cards.ar: وإذا وصف الطلاق بضرب من الزيادة والشدة كان بائنا مثل أن يقول: أنت طالق بائن أو طالق أشد الطلاق أو أفحش الطلاق أو طلاق الشيطان والبدعة وكالجبل وملء البيت
cards.en: If he describes the talaq as extra or harsh, it is final (ba'in): "divorced, separated", "the harshest divorce", "the ugliest divorce", "the divorce of Shaytan", "like a mountain", "filling the house".

cards.ask: He means a single divorce. Which of these give a final (ba'in) talaq?

options.text: "You are divorced, the harshest divorce"
"You are divorced, like a mountain"
"You are separated", meaning divorce
"You are divorced"
"Count your 'idda", meaning divorce

source: كان بائنا مثل أن يقول: أنت طالق بائن أو طالق أشد الطلاق
وكالجبل وملء البيت
إذا نوى بها الطلاق كانت واحدة بائنة
اعتدي واستبرئي رحمك وأنت واحدة
cards.why: Harsh descriptions and most hints give a final talaq. "You are divorced" and "Count your 'idda" give a revocable one.

lessons.title: Part of her, half a talaq, and the forced

cards.title: Her whole self
cards.ar: وإذا أضاف الطلاق إلى جملها أو إلى ما يعبر به عن الجملة وقع الطلاق
cards.en: If he links the talaq to her whole self, or to a part that stands for the whole person in Arabic (her neck, her soul, her body, her face), the talaq happens.

cards.title: A share of her
cards.ar: جزءا شائعا منها مثل أن يقول: نصفك أو ثلثك
cards.en: The same if he divorces a share of her, like "half of you" or "a third of you".

cards.ask: Yasir says to his wife, "Half of you is divorced." Does a talaq happen?
options: Yes: half of her stands for all of her
No: only her whole self can be divorced
No: half of a person means nothing
cards.source: جزءا شائعا منها مثل أن يقول: نصفك أو ثلثك
cards.why: A share of her, like half or a third, is divorced just like her whole self.

cards.title: A hand or a foot
cards.ar: وإن قال: يدك أو رجلك طالق لم يقع الطلاق
cards.en: But if he says "Your hand is divorced" or "Your foot is divorced", no talaq happens: a hand or foot does not stand for the whole person.

cards.ask: Does this phrase cause talaq?
source: أو عنقك طالق أو روحك طالق أو بدنك أو جسدك
أو وجهك
وإن قال: يدك أو رجلك طالق لم يقع الطلاق
cards.why: The neck, soul and face stand for her whole self. A hand or a foot does not.

cards.title: Half a talaq
cards.ar: وإن طلقها نصف تطليقة أو ثلث تطليقة كانت طلقة واحدة
cards.en: If he gives her half a talaq or a third of a talaq, it counts as one whole talaq.

cards.ask: Salman says, "You are divorced with half a talaq." How many talaqs happen?
options: None: half a talaq is nothing
cards.source: وإن طلقها نصف تطليقة أو ثلث تطليقة كانت طلقة واحدة
cards.why: Half a talaq counts as one whole talaq.

cards.title: Forced, drunk, or unable to speak
cards.ar: وطلاق المكره والسكران واقع ويقع طلاق الأخرس بالإشارة
cards.en: The talaq of a man who was forced, and of a man who is drunk, still happens. A man who cannot speak divorces by a sign.

cards.ask: Whose talaq happens?

options.text: A man forced to say it
A drunk man
A man who cannot speak, by a clear sign
A man talking in his sleep
An insane man

source: وطلاق المكره والسكران واقع ويقع طلاق الأخرس بالإشارة
ولا يقع طلاق الصبي والمجنون والنائم
cards.why: The forced, the drunk and the mute (by a sign) are held to their talaq. The sleeper and the insane are not.

cards.ask: Nabil is forced by threats to say to his wife, "Your neck is divorced." Does a talaq happen?
options: Yes: forced or not, a talaq happens
No: a forced talaq never happens
No: only her whole self can be divorced
source: وطلاق المكره والسكران واقع
وإذا أضاف الطلاق إلى جملها أو إلى ما يعبر به عن الجملة وقع الطلاق
cards.why: Yes. A forced talaq still happens, and "your neck" stands for her whole self.

lessons.title: Linking divorce to a condition
lessons.arabic: وإن أضافه إلى شرط وقع عقب الشرط

cards.title: Linked to marrying her
cards.ar: وإذا أضاف الطلاق إلى النكاح وقع عقيب النكاح مثل أن يقول: إن تزوجتك فأنت طالق أو كل امرأة أتزوجها فهي طالق
cards.en: If a man links a talaq to marrying her, it happens straight after the nikah (the marriage contract). For example: "If I marry you, you are divorced", or "Every woman I marry is divorced".

cards.ask: Before any nikah, Faisal says to Huda, "If I marry you, you are divorced." Then they marry. What happens?
options: The talaq happens straight after the nikah
Nothing: she was not his wife when he said it
The nikah itself is not valid
cards.source: وإذا أضاف الطلاق إلى النكاح وقع عقيب النكاح
cards.why: He linked the talaq to marrying her, so it happens straight after the nikah.

cards.title: Linked to a condition
cards.ar: وإن أضافه إلى شرط وقع عقب الشرط مثل أن يقول لامرأته: إن دخلت الدار فأنت طالق
cards.en: If he links it to a condition, it happens as soon as the condition is met. For example, to his wife: "If you enter the house, you are divorced."

cards.title: Only a husband, or linked to marriage
cards.ar: إلا أن يكون الحالف مالكا أو يضيفه إلى ملك
cards.en: Such a conditional talaq is only valid if the man saying it is already her husband, or he links it to marrying her.

cards.ask: Hamza says to a woman he is not married to, "If you enter the house, you are divorced." Later he marries her, and she enters the house. Is she divorced?
options: No: he was not yet her husband
Yes, but only if he enters with her
cards.source: وإن قال لأجنبية: إن دخلت الدار فأنت طالق ثم تزوجها فدخلت الدار لم تطلق
cards.why: No. When he said it he was not her husband, and he did not link it to marrying her.

cards.title: Condition words
cards.ar: وألفاظ الشرط: إن وإذا وإذ ما وكل وكلما ومتى ومتى ما
cards.en: The condition words are seven: 1) in (if), 2) idha (when), 3) idh ma (when), 4) kull (every), 5) kullama (whenever), 6) mata (whenever), 7) mata ma (at whatever time).

cards.ask: Which of these are condition words?

options.text: In (if)
Idha (when)
Kullama (whenever)
Mata (whenever)
Illa (except)
Ma'a (with)

source: وألفاظ الشرط: إن وإذا وإذ ما وكل وكلما ومتى ومتى ما
وإن قال: ثلاثا إلا اثنتين
cards.why: In, idha, kullama and mata are among the seven. "Except" and "with" change the number of talaqs, not a condition.

cards.title: Kullama repeats
cards.ar: ففي كل هذه الشروط إذا وجد الشرط انحلت اليمين إلا في كلما فإن الطلاق يتكرر بتكرار الشرط حتى يقع ثلاث تطليقات فإن تزوجها بعد ذلك وتكرر الشرط لم يقع شيء
cards.en: A conditional talaq is called a yamin (an oath). With all these words, once the condition happens the oath is used up, except kullama (whenever): the talaq repeats each time the condition happens, until three have fallen. If he marries her again after that and the condition happens again, nothing happens.

cards.ask: Which word makes the talaq repeat? Complete it.
cards.ar: إلا في ____ فإن الطلاق يتكرر بتكرار الشرط
cards.source: إلا في كلما فإن الطلاق يتكرر بتكرار الشرط
cards.why: كلما: with "whenever", the talaq repeats each time the condition happens.

cards.title: If the marriage ends in between
cards.ar: وزوال الملك بعد اليمين لا يبطلها فإن وجد في ملكه انحلت اليمين ووقع الطلاق وإن وجد في غير الملك انحلت اليمين ولم يقع شيء
cards.en: If the marriage ends after he made the oath, the oath is not cancelled. If the condition then happens while she is his wife, the oath is used up and the talaq happens. If it happens while she is not his wife, the oath is used up and nothing happens.

cards.ask: Adam told his wife, "If you enter the house, you are divorced." Then he gave her one final talaq, and after her 'idda ended she entered the house. Later they marry again. Can that old condition still divorce her?
options: No: it was used up outside the marriage
Yes: it waits for the new marriage
Yes, and now it gives all three talaqs at once
cards.source: وإن وجد في غير الملك انحلت اليمين ولم يقع شيء
cards.why: The condition happened while she was not his wife, so the oath was used up and nothing happened.

cards.ask: Kamal tells his wife, "Whenever you enter the house, you are divorced." She enters it three separate times while they are married. How many talaqs happen?
options: None: "whenever" is not a condition word
source: وألفاظ الشرط: إن وإذا وإذ ما وكل وكلما
إلا في كلما فإن الطلاق يتكرر بتكرار الشرط حتى يقع ثلاث
cards.why: With kullama the talaq repeats each time the condition happens, until three have fallen.

lessons.title: When they disagree about the condition
lessons.arabic: فالقول قول الزوج فيه إلا أن تقيم البينة

cards.title: The husband's word
cards.ar: وإذا اختلفا في وجود الشرط فالقول قول الزوج فيه إلا أن تقيم البينة
cards.en: If they disagree about whether the condition happened, the husband's word is accepted, unless she brings bayyina (proof through witnesses).

cards.ask: Nadia says she entered the house, so the conditional talaq has happened. Her husband says she did not. Nobody saw. Whose word is accepted?
cards.source: وإذا اختلفا في وجود الشرط فالقول قول الزوج فيه إلا أن تقيم البينة
cards.why: The husband's word is accepted, since she has no witnesses.

cards.title: What only she can know
cards.ar: فإن كان الشرط لا يعلم إلا من وجهتها فالقول قولها في حق نفسها مثل أن يقول: إن حضت فأنت طالق فقالت: قد حضت طلقت
cards.en: If the condition is something only she can know, her word is accepted for herself. For example, he says "If you have your period, you are divorced", and she says "My period has come": she is divorced.

cards.title: Only for herself
cards.ar: وإذا قال: إذا حضت فأنت طالق وفلانة فقالت: قد حضت طلقت هي ولم تطلق فلانة
cards.en: If he says "When you have your period, you and my other wife are divorced", and she says her period has come, she is divorced but the other wife is not. Her word only counts for herself.

cards.ask: A man says to his wife Amna, "When you have your period, you and Saba are divorced." Amna says, "My period has come." Who is divorced?
cards.source: طلقت هي ولم تطلق فلانة
cards.why: Only Amna. Her word is accepted for herself, not for the other wife.

cards.title: Blood that lasts three days
cards.ar: وإذا قال لها: إذا حضت فأنت طالق فرأت الدم لم يقع الطلاق حتى يستمر ثلاثة أيام فإذا تمت ثلاثة أيام حكمنا بوقوع الطلاق من حين حاضت
cards.en: If he says "When you have your period, you are divorced" and she sees blood, the talaq does not happen until it has lasted three days (the shortest a period can be). Once three days are complete, the talaq is counted from when the bleeding began.

cards.title: "A whole period"
cards.ar: وإذا قال لها: إذا حضت حيضة فأنت طالق لم تطلق حتى تطهر من حيضها
cards.en: If he says "When you have a (whole) period, you are divorced", she is not divorced until she is clean from that period.

cards.ask: He said, "When you have a whole period, you are divorced." Her period began on Monday and ended on Saturday. When is she divorced?
options: On Saturday, when she is clean
cards.source: إذا حضت حيضة فأنت طالق لم تطلق حتى تطهر من حيضها
cards.why: With "a whole period", she is not divorced until she is clean from it.

cards.ask: He said, "When you have your period, you are divorced." Blood appeared on Monday and lasted five days. From when is the talaq counted?
source: لم يقع الطلاق حتى يستمر ثلاثة أيام
حكمنا بوقوع الطلاق من حين حاضت
cards.why: Once the blood has lasted three days, the talaq is counted from when it began: Monday.

lessons.title: How many talaqs, where and when

cards.title: Three or two
cards.ar: وطلاق الحرة ثلاث حرا كان زوجها أو عبدا
cards.en: A free wife can be divorced up to three times, whether her husband is free or enslaved. In al-Quduri's time an enslaved wife had two talaqs, whoever her husband was. The number goes by the wife.

cards.ask: In al-Quduri's time, an enslaved man was married to a free woman. How many talaqs does her marriage hold?
options: Three: it goes by the wife
Two: it goes by the husband
source: وطلاق الأمة تطليقتان
وطلاق الحرة ثلاث حرا كان زوجها أو عبدا
cards.why: Three. A free wife has three talaqs, whether her husband is free or not.

cards.title: Before the marriage is consummated
cards.ar: وإذا طلق الرجل امرأته قبل الدخول بها ثلاثا وقعن عليها فإن فرق الطلاق بانت بالأولى ولم تقع الثانية
cards.en: If he divorces her three times in one go before the marriage is consummated, all three happen. But if he gives them one by one, the first separates her (she has no 'idda), so the second does not happen.

cards.ask: Before consummation, Imran says, "You are divorced. You are divorced. You are divorced." How many talaqs happen?
cards.source: فإن فرق الطلاق بانت بالأولى ولم تقع الثانية
cards.why: One. Given one by one before consummation, the first separates her and the rest have nothing to fall on.

cards.title: "One before one", "one after one"
cards.ar: وإن قال لها واحدة قبلها واحدة وقعت اثنتان وإن قال واحدة بعدها وقعت واحدة وإن قال واحدة بعد واحدة أو مع واحدة أو معها واحدة وقعت اثنتان
cards.en: Still before consummation: "one, before which is one" gives two. "One, after which is one" gives one. "One after one", "one with one" and "one, with it one" give two. And "You are divorced, and one" gives one.
