cards.ar: وإذا كانت يد المقطوع ويد القاطع شلاء أو ناقصه الأصابع فالمقطوع بالخيار: إن شاء قطع اليد المعيبة ولا شيء له غيرها وإن شاء آخذ الأرض كاملا
cards.en: If the cutter's hand is paralysed or missing fingers, the victim chooses: have that faulty hand cut and get nothing more, or take the full arsh (money for an injury).

cards.ask: Faris, whose right hand is missing two fingers, cuts off Ahmad's healthy right hand on purpose. What may Ahmad choose?
options: His faulty hand alone, or the full arsh
His faulty hand plus money for the two fingers
Only the arsh, never the hand
cards.source: فالمقطوع بالخيار: إن شاء قطع اليد المعيبة ولا شيء له غيرها
cards.why: He chooses the faulty hand with nothing else, or the full arsh.

cards.title: A wound bigger on one head than the other
cards.ar: ومن شج رجلا فاستوعب الشجة ما بين قرنية وهي لا تستوعب ما بين قرني الشاج فالمشجوج بالخيار: إن شاء اقتض بمقدار شجته يبتدئ من أي الجانبين شاء وإن شاء أخذ الأرش
cards.en: If a head wound (shajja) runs across the victim's whole head, but would not cover the striker's larger head, the victim chooses: take qisas the length of his own wound, starting from either side, or take the arsh. There is no qisas for the tongue or the private part, unless its tip is cut.

cards.ask: A deliberate injury between two free Muslim men. Is there qisas?
items: Cutting off the foot at the joint
Cutting off the soft part of the nose
Cutting the arm from the middle of the forearm
source: قطعت يده وكذلك الرجل ومارن الأنف والأذن
ومن قطع يد رجل من نصف الساعد أو جرحه جائفة فبرأ منها فلا قصاص عليه
ولا قصاص في اللسان
cards.why: A foot at the joint and the soft nose can be matched. The mid-forearm, the tongue and a healed ja'ifa cannot.

cards.ask: Which statement matches al-Quduri?
options: For injuries below a life, there is no shibh 'amd
There is qisas for any broken bone
There is no qisas for limbs between a Muslim and a non-Muslim
source: وليس فيما دون النفس شبه عمد إنما هو عمد أو خطأ
ولا قصاص في عظم إلا في السن
ويجب القصاص في الأطراف بين المسلم والكافر
cards.why: Below a life an injury is deliberate or a mistake. Bones other than teeth have no qisas, and limbs between a Muslim and a non-Muslim do.

cards.title: Settling for money
cards.ar: وإذا اصطلح القاتل وأولياء المقتول على مال سقط القصاص ووجب المال قليلا كان أو كثيرا
cards.en: If the killer and the victim's family make a settlement (sulh) for money, the qisas falls away and the money is owed, whether little or much.

cards.title: One heir forgives
cards.ar: فإن عفا أحد الشركاء أو صالح من نصيبه على عوض سقط حق الباقين من القصاص وكان لهم نصيبهم من الدية
cards.en: If one of the heirs who share the right forgives, or settles his share for payment, the others lose their right to qisas too. They get their share of the diya (blood money) instead.

cards.ask: A man is killed on purpose. He leaves three sons. The eldest forgives the killer. What do the other two get?
options: Qisas, as two of the three heirs
cards.source: سقط حق الباقين من القصاص وكان لهم نصيبهم من الدية
cards.why: Once one heir forgives, qisas falls for all, and the others take their part of the diya.

cards.title: Many killers, or many victims
cards.ar: وإذا قتل جماعة واحدا عمدا اقتض من جميعهم وإذا قتل واحد جماعة فحضر أولياء المقتولين قتل بجماعتهم ولا شيء لهم غير ذلك فإن حضر واحد قتل له وسقط حق الباقين
cards.en: If a group kill one man on purpose, qisas is taken from all of them. If one man kills a group, and all their families come, he is killed for all of them and they get nothing else. If only one family comes, he is killed for them and the others' right falls away.

cards.ask: Four men together kill Sami on purpose. What does the court do?
options: Qisas on one of them only
Each pays a quarter of the diya
cards.source: وإذا قتل جماعة واحدا عمدا اقتض من جميعهم
cards.why: When a group kill one person, qisas is taken from every one of them.

cards.title: If the killer dies
cards.ar: ومن وجب عليه القصاص فمات سقط عنه القصاص
cards.en: If someone who owes qisas dies, the qisas falls away.

cards.title: Two men cut one hand
cards.ar: وإذا قطع رجلان يد رجل فلا قصاص على واحد منهما وعليهما نصف الدية
cards.en: If two men together cut off one man's hand, there is no qisas on either. The two owe half the diya.

cards.ask: Two men together cut off Umar's hand on purpose. What do they owe?
options: Each of them loses a hand in qisas
cards.source: وإذا قطع رجلان يد رجل فلا قصاص على واحد منهما وعليهما نصف الدية
cards.why: Two hands for one cannot be matched, so there is no qisas, and they share half the diya.

cards.title: One man cuts two hands
cards.ar: وإن قطع واحد يميني رجلين فحضرا فلهما أن يقطعا يده ويأخذا منه نصف الدية ويقتسمانه نصفين وإن حضر واحد منهما فقطع يده فللآخر عليه نصف الدية
cards.en: If one man cuts off the right hands of two men, and both come, they cut his hand and take half the diya from him, split between them. If only one comes and cuts his hand, the other is owed half the diya.

cards.ask: Rami cuts off the right hands of Ali and Badr on purpose. Only Ali comes to court, and he has Rami's hand cut. What does Badr get?
cards.source: وإن حضر واحد منهما فقطع يده فللآخر عليه نصف الدية
cards.why: If one comes and takes the hand, the other is owed half the diya by the cutter.

cards.title: A slave's confession, and one arrow through two
cards.ar: وإذا أقر العبد بقتل العمد لزمه القود ومن رمى رجلا عمدا فنفذ السهم منه إلى آخر فماتا فعليه القصاص للأول والدية الثاني على عاقلته
cards.en: If a slave confesses to deliberate killing, he owes qawad (qisas). If someone shoots a man on purpose and the arrow goes through him into another, and both die, he owes qisas for the first, and diya for the second, paid by his 'aqila.

cards.ask: Ghalib shoots at Nadir on purpose. The arrow passes through Nadir and kills Hani behind him. Both die. What does Ghalib owe?
options: Qisas for Nadir, diya for Hani
cards.source: فعليه القصاص للأول والدية الثاني على عاقلته
cards.why: The first was deliberate, so qisas. The second was a mistake, so diya on the 'aqila.

cards.ask: Which of these make the qisas fall away?

options.text: The family settle with the killer for money
One of the heirs forgives
The killer dies
The killer is a slave who confessed
A group of men killed one man together

source: سقط القصاص ووجب المال
فإن عفا أحد الشركاء
ومن وجب عليه القصاص فمات سقط عنه القصاص
وإذا أقر العبد بقتل العمد لزمه القود
اقتض من جميعهم
cards.why: Settlement, one heir's forgiveness and the killer's death drop the qisas. A slave's confession binds him, and a group are all subject to qisas.

lessons.title: How much the diya is
lessons.arabic: ودية شبه العمد مائة من الإبل

cards.title: The heavy diya of shibh 'amd
cards.ar: ودية شبه العمد عند أبي حنيفة وأبي يوسف مائة من الإبل أرباعا: خمس وعشرون بنت مخاض وخمس وعشرون بنت لبون وخمس وعشرون حقة وخمس وعشرون جذعة
cards.en: Diya is blood money for a life or an injury. For shibh 'amd (striking on purpose with what does not usually kill), the killer's 'aqila owe a heavy diya. For Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf it is 100 camels in quarters: 25 each of bint makhad, bint labun, hiqqa and jadha'a, she-camels of rising ages.

cards.ask: Shibh 'amd, for Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf: how many jadha'a camels are in the heavy diya?
source: عند أبي حنيفة وأبي يوسف مائة من الإبل أرباعا
وخمس وعشرون حقة وخمس وعشرون جذعة
cards.why: The 100 camels are in four groups of 25, and the jadha'a are one of them.

cards.title: Only camels make it heavy
cards.ar: ولا يثبت التغليظ إلا في الإبل خاصة فإن قضي بالدية من غير الإبل لم تتغلظ
cards.en: Making the diya heavy only applies to camels. If the diya is judged in something else, it is not made heavy.

cards.title: The diya of a mistake
cards.ar: والدية في الخطأ مائة من الإبل أخماسا: عشرون بنت مخاض وعشرون ابن مخاض وعشرون بنت لبون وعشرون حقة
cards.en: For killing by mistake, the diya is on the 'aqila and the kaffara is on the killer. The diya is 100 camels in fifths: groups of twenty, such as 20 bint makhad, 20 ibn makhad (young male camels), 20 bint labun and 20 hiqqa.

cards.ask: Which diya is this (shibh 'amd as Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf give it)?
source: مائة من الإبل أرباعا
وخمس وعشرون جذعة
مائة من الإبل أخماسا
وعشرون ابن مخاض
cards.why: For Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf, shibh 'amd is in quarters of 25 and includes jadha'a. A mistake is in fifths of 20 and includes young male camels.

cards.ask: Rami shoots at a target and by mistake kills a man. Who pays what?
options: The 'aqila pay; Rami does the kaffara
The 'aqila pay and also do the kaffara
cards.source: وقتل الخطإ جب به الدية على العاقلة والكفارة على القاتل
cards.why: For a mistake, the diya falls on the 'aqila, and the kaffara on the killer himself.

cards.title: Other kinds of payment
cards.ar: ولا تثبت الدية إلا من هذه الأنواع الثلاثة عند أبي حنيفة وقال أبو يوسف ومحمد: من البقر مائتا بقرة ومن الغنم ألفا شاة ومن الحلل مائتا حلة كل حلة ثوبان
cards.en: For Abu Hanifa, the diya is paid only in the kinds he names. Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad also allow 200 cows, 2,000 sheep, or 200 suits of clothes (each suit two garments).

cards.title: Muslim and dhimmi alike
cards.ar: ودية المسلم والذمي سواء
cards.en: The diya of a Muslim and of a dhimmi (a non-Muslim living under Muslim rule) is the same.

cards.ask: A dhimmi merchant is killed by mistake. How does his diya compare with a Muslim's?
cards.source: ودية المسلم والذمي سواء
cards.why: Al-Quduri says the diya of a Muslim and a dhimmi are equal.

cards.ask: Which statement matches al-Quduri?
options: Only a diya in camels can be made heavy
A mistake's diya is 100 camels in quarters
A mistaken killer pays it himself
source: فإن قضي بالدية من غير الإبل لم تتغلظ
مائة من الإبل أخماسا
الدية على العاقلة والكفارة على القاتل
cards.why: Only camels are made heavy. A mistake's diya is in fifths, and the 'aqila pay it.

lessons.title: Diya for parts of the body

cards.title: A full diya
cards.ar: وفي النفس الدية وفي المارن الدية وفي اللسان الدية وفي الذكر الدية وفي العقل إذا ضرب رأسه فذهب عقله الدية
cards.en: A full diya is due for a life, for the soft part of the nose (marin), for the tongue, for the male organ, and for the mind, if a blow to the head takes away a person's sanity.

cards.ask: A blow to Hasan's head takes away his sanity, though he lives. What is due?
cards.source: وفي العقل إذا ضرب رأسه فذهب عقله الدية
cards.why: Losing the mind by a blow to the head is a full diya, like losing a life.

cards.title: Hair, and parts that come in pairs
cards.ar: وفي اللحية إذا حلقت فلم تنبت الدية وفي شعر الرأس الدية وفي الحاجبين الدية وفي العينين الدية وفي اليدين الدية وفي الرجلين الدية وفي الأذنين الدية وفي الشفتين الدية وفي الأنثيين الدية وفي ثديي المرأة الدية
cards.en: A full diya also for the beard if it is shaved and never grows back, the hair of the head, both eyebrows, both eyes, both hands, both feet, both ears, both lips, the two testicles, and a woman's two breasts.

cards.title: One of a pair
cards.ar: وفي كل واحد من هذه الأشياء نصف الدية
cards.en: For one of each of these pairs, half the diya.

cards.ask: By mistake, Adil puts out one of Jamal's eyes. A full diya is 100 camels. How many camels are due?
cards.source: وفي كل واحد من هذه الأشياء نصف الدية
cards.why: One of a pair is half the diya: 50 camels.

cards.title: Eyelids
cards.ar: وفي أشفار العينين الدية وفي أحدهما ربع الدية
cards.en: For the eyelids (the rims with lashes) of both eyes, a full diya. There are four, so one is a quarter of the diya.

cards.ask: By mistake, one of Kamil's eyelids is torn away. A full diya is 100 camels. How many camels are due?
cards.source: وفي أشفار العينين الدية وفي أحدهما ربع الدية
cards.why: There are four eyelids sharing one diya, so one is a quarter: 25 camels.

cards.title: Fingers and teeth
cards.ar: وفي كل إصبع من أصابع اليدين والرجلين عشر الدية والأصابع كلها سواء وكل إصبع فيها ثلاثة مفاصل ففي أحدهما ثلث دية الإصبع وما فيها مفصلان ففي أحدهما نصف دية الإصبع وفي كل سن خمس من الإبل والأسنان والأضراس كلها سواء
cards.en: Each finger or toe is a tenth of the diya, and all fingers are equal. A finger with three joints: one joint is a third of a finger's diya. A finger with two joints (the thumb): one joint is half. Each tooth is five camels, and front teeth and molars are equal.

cards.ask: By mistake, the top joint of Lutfi's thumb is cut off. A thumb has two joints. A full diya is 100 camels. How many camels are due?
source: وفي كل إصبع من أصابع اليدين والرجلين عشر الدية
وما فيها مفصلان ففي أحدهما نصف دية الإصبع
cards.why: A finger is a tenth: 10 camels. One of two joints is half of that: 5 camels.

cards.ask: In an accident, Samir loses three teeth: two molars and one front tooth. How many camels are due?
cards.source: وفي كل سن خمس من الإبل والأسنان والأضراس كلها سواء
cards.why: Each tooth is 5 camels, front or back alike: 3 × 5 = 15.

cards.title: Losing the use
cards.ar: ومن ضرب عضوا فأذهب منفعة ففيه دية كاملة كما لو قطعه كاليد إذا شلت والعين إذا ذهب ضوءها
cards.en: If a blow takes away a limb's use, it is a full diya for it, as if it were cut off: like a hand that becomes paralysed, or an eye that loses its sight.

cards.ask: For which of these is a full diya due?

options.text: Cutting off the tongue
A beard shaved that never grows back
A blow that takes away the mind
Both hands left paralysed by a blow
One ear
One tooth

source: وفي اللسان الدية
وفي اللحية إذا حلقت فلم تنبت الدية
فذهب عقله الدية
كاليد إذا شلت
وفي كل واحد من هذه الأشياء نصف الدية
وفي كل سن خمس من الإبل
cards.why: Tongue, beard, mind and both hands (lost use counts as cut) are a full diya. One ear is half, and a tooth is five camels.

cards.title: Ten head wounds
cards.ar: والشجاج عشرة: الحارصة والدامعة والدامية والباضعة والمتلاحمة والسمحاق والموضحه والهاشمة والمنقلة والأمة
cards.en: A shajja is a wound to the head or face. There are ten, from lightest to deepest. The last four are mudiha (shows the bone), hashima (breaks the bone), munaqqila (moves the bone out of place), and amma (reaches the lining of the brain).

cards.ask: Put these head wounds in the book's order, from lightest to deepest.
cards.source: والدامية والباضعة والمتلاحمة والسمحاق والموضحه والهاشمة والمنقلة والأمة
cards.why: The book lists them by depth: damiya, then simhaq, mudiha, hashima, munaqqila, and amma last.

cards.title: Qisas only for the mudiha
cards.ar: ففي الموضحه القصاص إن كانت عمدا ولا قصاص في بقية الشجاج وما دون الموضحة ففيه حكومة عدل
cards.en: A deliberate mudiha has qisas. None of the other head wounds have qisas. For wounds lighter than a mudiha there is a hukumat 'adl: a fair amount fixed by just judgement.

cards.ask: Rafi deliberately strikes a man's head and leaves a damiya, a bleeding wound lighter than a mudiha. What is due?
cards.source: ولا قصاص في بقية الشجاج وما دون الموضحة ففيه حكومة عدل
cards.why: Only the mudiha has qisas. Lighter wounds get a hukumat 'adl.

cards.title: Fixed amounts
cards.ar: وفي الموضحة إن كانت خطأ نصف عشر الدية وفي الهاشمية عشر الدية وفي المنقلة عشر ونصف عشر الدية وفي الأمة ثلث الدية وفي الجائفة ثلث الدية فإن نفذت فهي جائفتان ففيها ثلثا الدية
cards.en: By mistake, a mudiha is a twentieth of the diya. A hashima is a tenth. A munaqqila is a tenth and a twentieth. An amma is a third. A jaifa (a wound that reaches inside the body) is a third, and if it goes right through, it counts as two jaifas: two thirds.

cards.ask: By mistake, Hadi's head wound moves the bone out of place: a munaqqila. A full diya is 100 camels. How many camels are due?
cards.source: وفي المنقلة عشر ونصف عشر الدية
cards.why: A tenth (10) plus a twentieth (5) makes 15 camels.

cards.ask: Fixed share, or a hukumat 'adl?
items: A wound lighter than a mudiha
source: وفي الموضحة إن كانت خطأ نصف عشر الدية وفي الهاشمية عشر الدية
وفي الأمة ثلث الدية وفي الجائفة ثلث الدية
وما دون الموضحة ففيه حكومة عدل
cards.why: Mudiha, hashima, amma and jaifa have fixed shares. Wounds lighter than a mudiha get a hukumat 'adl.

cards.ask: A spear wound by mistake goes into Wafi's body and out the other side. What part of the diya is due?
cards.source: فإن نفذت فهي جائفتان ففيها ثلثا الدية
cards.why: A jaifa that goes through counts as two jaifas: two thirds of the diya.

cards.title: Fingers, palm and forearm
cards.ar: وفي أصابع اليد نصف الدية وإن قطعها مع الكف ففيها الدية وإن قطعها مع نصف الساعد ففي الكف نصف الدية وفي الزيادة حكومة عدل وفي الإصبع الزائدة حكومة عدل
cards.en: All the fingers of one hand are half the diya. Cut with the palm, the palm goes with the fingers. Cut with half the forearm: half the diya for the hand, and a hukumat 'adl for the extra part. An extra finger gets a hukumat 'adl.

cards.ask: Fixed share, or a hukumat 'adl?
items: All five fingers of one hand
The fingers cut off together with the palm
The forearm part cut along with the hand
source: وفي أصابع اليد نصف الدية وإن قطعها مع الكف ففيها الدية
وفي الزيادة حكومة عدل وفي الإصبع الزائدة حكومة عدل
cards.why: The fingers, with or without the palm, are half the diya. An extra finger and the extra forearm get a hukumat 'adl.

cards.ask: By mistake, a man's ten fingers are all cut, five on each hand. What is due?
source: وفي أصابع اليد نصف الدية
وفي كل إصبع من أصابع اليدين والرجلين عشر الدية
cards.why: Each finger is a tenth, so one hand's fingers are half, and both hands make a full diya.

lessons.title: When injuries add up or heal

cards.title: A child's eye, and wounds that merge
cards.ar: وفي عين الصبي وذكره ولسانه إذا لم تعلم صحته حكومة عدل ومن شج رجلا موضحة فذهب عقله أو شعر رأسه دخل أرش الموضحة في الدية
cards.en: For a small child's eye, organ or tongue, when no one yet knows it was healthy, there is a hukumat 'adl. Arsh is the money due for an injury. If a mudiha takes away the victim's mind or the hair of his head, the mudiha's arsh is swallowed up in the full diya.

cards.title: When it is added on top
cards.ar: وإن ذهب سمعة أو بصره أو كلامه فعليه أرش الموضحة مع الدية
cards.en: But if the mudiha takes away his hearing, sight or speech, he owes the mudiha's arsh on top of the diya.

cards.ask: A mudiha causes this loss. Is the mudiha's arsh paid as well as the diya?
items: He loses the hair of his head
source: فذهب عقله أو شعر رأسه دخل أرش الموضحة في الدية
وإن ذهب سمعة أو بصره أو كلامه فعليه أرش الموضحة مع الدية
cards.why: Mind and head hair absorb the mudiha's arsh. Hearing, sight and speech get the arsh on top.

cards.title: A finger next to it, a tooth that grows back
cards.ar: ومن قطع إصبع رجل فشلت أخرى إلى جنبها ففيهما الأرش ولا قصاص فيه عند أبي حنيفة ومن قلع سن رجل فنبتت أخرى سقط الأرش
cards.en: If someone cuts a man's finger and the one next to it becomes paralysed, the arsh is due for both, and Abu Hanifa says there is no qisas. If someone knocks out a man's tooth and another grows in its place, the arsh falls away.

cards.ask: Ilyas knocks out a boy's tooth by mistake. A few months later a new tooth grows in its place. What is owed?
cards.source: ومن قلع سن رجل فنبتت أخرى سقط الأرش
cards.why: When another tooth grows in, the arsh falls away.

cards.title: A wound that heals without a trace
cards.ar: فالتحمت الجراحة ولم يبق لها أثر ونبت الشعر سقط الأرش عند أبي حنيفة
cards.en: If someone wounds a man's head and it heals with no mark, and the hair grows back, the arsh falls away (Abu Hanifa). Note: Abu Yusuf says he owes an arsh for the pain; Muhammad says he owes the doctor's fee.

cards.ask: Majid's head wound from a blow heals completely: no scar, and the hair grows back. What does al-Quduri say is owed?
options: The full arsh of the wound
cards.source: ونبت الشعر سقط الأرش عند أبي حنيفة
cards.why: For Abu Hanifa, whose view al-Quduri gives, the arsh falls away when the wound leaves no trace.

cards.title: Wait until it heals
cards.ar: ومن جرح رجلا جراحة لم يقتض منه حتى يبرأ ومن قطع يد رجل خطأ ثم قتله قبل البرء فعليه الدية وسقط أرش اليد
cards.en: For a wound, qisas is not taken until it heals. If someone cuts a man's hand by mistake and then kills him before it heals, he owes the diya, and the hand's arsh falls away.

cards.ask: By mistake Nabhan cuts off Ra'id's hand. Before it heals, Nabhan kills him by mistake. What is due?
options: One diya; the hand's arsh falls away
A diya plus half a diya for the hand
cards.source: ثم قتله قبل البرء فعليه الدية وسقط أرش اليد
cards.why: Killed before healing, the hand is swallowed up in the one diya.

cards.ask: Which statement matches al-Quduri?
options: Qisas for a wound waits until it heals
A child's tongue has a full diya
A mudiha that takes the hearing is swallowed in the diya
source: لم يقتض منه حتى يبرأ
وفي عين الصبي وذكره ولسانه إذا لم تعلم صحته حكومة عدل
وإن ذهب سمعة أو بصره أو كلامه فعليه أرش الموضحة مع الدية
cards.why: Qisas waits for healing. A child's tongue of unknown health gets a hukumat 'adl, and loss of hearing adds the mudiha's arsh.

lessons.title: Who pays, roads and animals
lessons.arabic: ومن حفر بئرا في طريق المسلمين

cards.title: Paid from the killer's own wealth
cards.ar: وكل عمد سقط فيه القصاص بشبهة فالدية في مال القاتل وكل أرش وجب بالصلح فهو في مال القاتل
cards.en: Whenever qisas for a deliberate killing falls away because of a doubt (shubha), the diya comes from the killer's own wealth. So does any arsh owed by a settlement.

cards.title: A father, and a confession
cards.ar: وإذا قتل الأب ابنه عمدا فالدية في ماله في ثلاث سنين وكل جناية اعترف بها الجاني فهي في ماله ولا يصدق على عاقلته
cards.en: If a father kills his son on purpose, the diya is from his own wealth, over three years. Any crime the wrongdoer confesses to is paid from his own wealth: his word is not believed against his 'aqila.

cards.ask: Mansur kills his son on purpose. There is no qisas for a father. How is the diya paid?
options: His own wealth, over three years
His own wealth, paid at once
cards.source: وإذا قتل الأب ابنه عمدا فالدية في ماله في ثلاث سنين
cards.why: A father's diya for his son comes from his own wealth, over three years.

cards.title: A child or insane person
cards.ar: وعمد الصبي والمجنون خطأ وفيه الدية على العاقلة
cards.en: What a child or an insane person does on purpose counts as a mistake: the diya is on the 'aqila.

cards.ask: Twelve-year-old Ziyad throws a stone at a man on purpose, and the man dies. Who pays the diya?
cards.source: وعمد الصبي والمجنون خطأ وفيه الدية على العاقلة
cards.why: What a child does on purpose is treated as a mistake, so the diya is on the 'aqila.

cards.ask: Who pays the diya?
items: A father who killed his son on purpose
A man who confessed to killing by mistake
An arsh agreed in a settlement
An insane man who killed on purpose
A man who killed by mistake, proven by witnesses
source: فالدية في ماله في ثلاث سنين
وكل جناية اعترف بها الجاني فهي في ماله
وكل أرش وجب بالصلح فهو في مال القاتل
وعمد الصبي والمجنون خطأ وفيه الدية على العاقلة
الدية على العاقلة
cards.why: A father, a confession and a settlement are paid from his own wealth. A child's act and a proven mistake fall on the 'aqila.

cards.title: Wells and stones in the road
cards.ar: ومن حفر بئرا في طريق المسلمين أو وضع حجرا فتلف بذلك إنسان فديته على عاقلته وإن تلف فيه بهيمة فضمانها في ماله
cards.en: If someone digs a well in the public road or puts a stone there, and a person dies by it, the diya is on his 'aqila. If an animal dies by it, he pays for it from his own wealth.

cards.title: Ledges and gutters
cards.ar: وإن أشرع في الطريق ورشنا أو ميزابا فسقط على إنسان فعطب فالدية على عاقلته ولا كفارة على حافر البئر وواضع الحجر
cards.en: If he builds a ledge or a gutter out over the road and it falls on someone, the diya is on his 'aqila. The one who dug the well or put the stone owes no kaffara (an act to make up for a killing).

cards.ask: Fahd digs a well in the public road. A neighbour's donkey falls in and dies. Who pays for the donkey?
cards.source: وإن تلف فيه بهيمة فضمانها في ماله
cards.why: For an animal, the digger pays from his own wealth; for a person, his 'aqila pay.

cards.title: His own land, and riders
cards.ar: ومن حفر بئرا في ملكه فعطب به إنسان لم يضمن والراكب ضامن لما وطئت الدابة وما أصابت بيدها أو كدمت ولا يضمن ما نفخت برجلها أو ذنبها
cards.en: A well dug in one's own property: he is not liable if someone dies in it. A rider is liable for what his animal treads on, strikes with its front leg, or bites. He is not liable for what it kicks with its hind leg or flicks with its tail.

cards.ask: Is the rider liable?
items: His horse treads on a child's foot
His horse strikes a man with its front leg
His horse kicks backwards with a hind leg
His horse hits someone with its tail
source: والراكب ضامن لما وطئت الدابة وما أصابت بيدها أو كدمت ولا يضمن ما نفخت برجلها أو ذنبها
cards.why: Treading, the front leg and biting are on the rider. A hind-leg kick and the tail are not.

cards.title: Driving and leading
cards.ar: والسائق ضامن لما أصابت بيدها أو رجلها والقائد ضامن لما أصابت بيدها دون رجلها ومن قاد قطارا فهو ضامن لما وطئ فإن كان معه سائق فالضمان عليهما
cards.en: One who drives an animal from behind is liable for its front and hind legs. One who leads it from the front is liable for its front leg only. One who leads a line of camels is liable for what they tread on; if someone drives them too, both are liable.

cards.ask: Is the man liable?
items: A driver's camel kicks a man with a hind leg
A leader's camel strikes a man with a front leg
A camel in a line he leads treads on a man
Someone slips on a rider's horse's dung in the road
source: فإن راثت أو بالت في الطريق فعطب به إنسان لم يضمن
والسائق ضامن لما أصابت بيدها أو رجلها والقائد ضامن لما أصابت بيدها
ومن قاد قطارا فهو ضامن لما وطئ
cards.why: The driver answers for both legs, the leader for the front leg, and the one leading a line for what it treads on. Dung or urine in the road is on no one.

cards.ask: Haytham leads his camel by the rope from the front. It kicks a man with its hind leg. Is Haytham liable?
options: No: only for its front leg
Yes: for both of its legs
cards.source: والقائد ضامن لما أصابت بيدها دون رجلها
cards.why: The leader answers for the front leg, not the hind leg. A driver behind would answer for both.

lessons.title: A slave's crime, a leaning wall, a slave's value
lessons.arabic: إما أن تدفعه بها أو تفديه

cards.title: When a slave harms by mistake
cards.ar: جناية خطإ قيل لمولاه: إما أن تدفعه بها أو تفديه فإن دفعه ملكه ولي الجناية وإن فداه بأرشها
cards.en: In al-Quduri's time, if a slave harmed someone by mistake, his master was told: hand him over for it, or ransom him by paying. If he hands him over, the victim's side (wali al-jinaya) own him. If he pays the arsh and the slave harms again, the second case is like the first.

cards.ask: A slave harms two people by mistake, one after the other. What can his master do?
options: Hand him to both, or pay both arshes
Pay the first victim's arsh and nothing more
Hand him to the first victim alone
cards.source: إما أن تدفعه إلى ولي الجنايتين يقتسمان على قدر حقيهما وإما أن تفديه بأرش كل واحدة منهما
cards.why: With two victims, the master hands him to both, shared by their rights, or pays both arshes.

cards.title: Freeing him afterwards
cards.ar: وإن أعتقه المولى وهو لا يعلم بالجناية ضمن الأقل من قيمته ومن أرشها وإن باعه المولى أو أعتقه بعد العلم بالجناية وجب عليه الأرش
cards.en: If the master frees the slave without knowing of the harm, he pays whichever is less: the slave's value or the arsh. If he sells or frees him after knowing, he owes the full arsh.

cards.ask: A slave worth 800 dirhams harms someone by mistake; the arsh is 1,000. Not knowing, the master frees him. How much does the master owe?
cards.source: وإن أعتقه المولى وهو لا يعلم بالجناية ضمن الأقل من قيمته ومن أرشها
cards.why: Not knowing, he owes the lesser of the value (800) and the arsh (1,000): 800.

cards.title: A mudabbar or umm walad
cards.ar: وإذا جنى المدبر أو أم الولد جناية خطأ ضمن المولى الأقل من قيمته ومن أرشها
cards.en: A mudabbar is a slave to be freed when his master dies. An umm walad is a slave woman who bore her master's child. If either harms someone by mistake, the master pays whichever is less: the slave's value or the arsh.

cards.title: A second harm
cards.ar: فإن جنى أخرى وقد دفع المولى القيمة إلى ولي الأولى بقضاء فلا شيء عليه ويتبع ولي الجناية الثانية ولي الجناية الأولى فيشاركه فيما أخذ وإن كان المولى دفع القيمة بغير قضاء فالولي بالخيار: إن شاء اتبع المولى وإن شاء اتبع ولي الجناية الأولى
cards.en: If a second harm follows after the master paid the value to the first victim by court order, he owes nothing more: the second victim shares in what the first took. If he paid without a court order, the second victim may follow the master or the first victim.

cards.ask: A mudabbar harms Ali by mistake. By court order the master pays Ali the mudabbar's value. Then the mudabbar harms Omar. Whom does Omar turn to?
options: Ali, to share in what he took
The master, for a second payment
cards.source: بقضاء فلا شيء عليه ويتبع ولي الجناية الثانية ولي الجناية الأولى فيشاركه فيما أخذ
cards.why: After paying by court order the master owes nothing more; Omar shares with Ali.

cards.title: A wall leaning over the road
cards.ar: وإذا مال الحائط إلى طريق المسلمين فطولب صاحبه بنقضه وأشهد عليه فلم ينقض في مدة يقدر على نقضه حتى سقط ضمن ما تلف به من نفس أو مال ويستوي أن يطالبه بنقضه مسلم أو ذمي وإن مال إلى دار رجل فالمطالبة إلى مالك الدار خاصة
cards.en: If a wall leans over the public road, and its owner is asked before witnesses to pull it down but does not in the time he could, he is liable for the lives or property it destroys when it falls. A Muslim or a dhimmi may ask. For a wall leaning over a house, only its owner may ask.

cards.ask: Murad's wall leans over the road. His dhimmi neighbour asks him before witnesses to pull it down. Murad had a week to do it and did nothing. It falls and breaks a merchant's jars. Is Murad liable?
options: Yes, Murad is liable for them
No: a dhimmi's demand does not count
source: فطولب صاحبه بنقضه وأشهد عليه فلم ينقض في مدة يقدر على نقضه حتى سقط ضمن
ويستوي أن يطالبه بنقضه مسلم أو ذمي
cards.why: He was asked before witnesses, had the time, and did not act. A Muslim's or a dhimmi's demand counts the same.

cards.ask: Two horsemen ride into each other, and both die. Who pays?
options: Each one's 'aqila pay the other's diya
No one: each of them caused his own death
The public treasury pays both diyas
cards.source: وإذا اصطدم فارسان فماتا فعلى عاقلة كل واحد منهما دية الآخر
cards.why: Each one's 'aqila pay the diya of the other rider.

cards.title: The value of a slave
cards.ar: وإذا قتل رجل عبدا خطأ فعليه قيمته لا يزاد على عشرة آلاف درهم فإن كانت قيمته عشرة آلاف أو أكثر قضي عليه بعشرة آلاف إلا عشرة
cards.en: If a man kills a slave by mistake, he owes the slave's value, but never more than 10,000 dirhams: at 10,000 or more, it is judged at 10,000 less ten. Lower caps hold for a slave woman (5,000 less ten) and a slave's hand (half his value, at most 5,000 less five).

cards.ask: A slave worth 15,000 dirhams is killed by mistake. How much is owed?
cards.source: فإن كانت قيمته عشرة آلاف أو أكثر قضي عليه بعشرة آلاف إلا عشرة
cards.why: At 10,000 or more, the judgement is 10,000 less ten: 9,990.

cards.ask: Which are true?

options.text: A slave woman worth more than the diya is judged at 5,000 less ten
A slave's hand is half his value, at most 5,000 less five
A master who frees his slave knowing of the harm owes the full arsh
Only a Muslim may demand that a leaning wall be pulled down

source: وفي الأمة إذا زادت قيمتها على الدية خمسة آلاف إلا عشرة
وفي يد العبد نصف القيمة لا يزاد على خمسة آلاف إلا خمسة وكل ما يقدر من دية الحر فهو مقدر من قيمة العبد
أو أعتقه بعد العلم بالجناية وجب عليه الأرش
مسلم أو ذمي
cards.why: The first three are in the text. A Muslim or a dhimmi may demand the wall be pulled down.

lessons.title: The unborn child, and the kaffara

cards.title: The ghurra
cards.ar: وإذا ضرب بطن امرأة فألقت جنينا ميتا فعليه غرة والغرة نصف عشر الدية
cards.en: If someone strikes a pregnant woman's belly and she loses the unborn child (janin), stillborn, he owes a ghurra. A ghurra is a twentieth of the diya.

cards.ask: A full diya is 100 camels. How many camels is a ghurra?
cards.source: والغرة نصف عشر الدية
cards.why: A twentieth of 100 is 5.

cards.title: Alive or not, mother or not
cards.ar: فإن ألقته حيا ثم مات فعليه دية كاملة وإن ألقته ميتا ثم ماتت الأم فعليه دية وغرة وإن ماتت الأم ثم ألقته ميتا فعليه دية في الأم ولا شيء في الجنين
cards.en: If the baby is born alive and then dies, a full diya. If it is stillborn and then the mother dies, a diya and a ghurra. If the mother dies first and then the stillborn baby comes, a diya for the mother and nothing for the unborn child.

cards.ask: After a blow to a pregnant woman, what is due?
items: Baby born alive, then dies; the mother lives
The mother dies, then the stillborn baby comes
Stillborn baby, then the mother dies
source: فألقت جنينا ميتا فعليه غرة
فإن ألقته حيا ثم مات فعليه دية كاملة
وإن ألقته ميتا ثم ماتت الأم فعليه دية وغرة
فعليه دية في الأم ولا شيء في الجنين
cards.why: Stillborn alone is a ghurra; born alive is a diya. The mother's death adds a diya, and if she died first, there is nothing for the unborn child.

cards.title: Who receives it, and a slave woman's child
cards.ar: وما يجب في الجنين موروث عنه وفي جنين الأمة إذا كان ذكرا نصف عشر قيمته لو كان حيا وعشر قيمته إن كان أنثى ولا كفارة في الجنين
cards.en: What is paid for the unborn child is inherited by its heirs. For a slave woman's unborn child: if a boy, a twentieth of what he would be worth alive; if a girl, a tenth of her value. There is no kaffara for an unborn child.

cards.ask: A slave woman loses her unborn boy after a blow. Alive, he would be worth 1,000 dirhams. How much is due?
cards.source: وفي جنين الأمة إذا كان ذكرا نصف عشر قيمته لو كان حيا
cards.why: For a boy, a twentieth of his value alive: 1,000 ÷ 20 = 50.

cards.title: The kaffara for killing
cards.ar: والكفارة في شبه العمد والخطإ: عتق رقبة مؤمنة فإن لم يجد فصيام شهرين متتابعين ولا يجزئ فيها الإطعام
cards.en: Kaffara is an act to make up for a wrong. For shibh 'amd and mistake, it is freeing a believing slave. If he cannot, he fasts two months in a row. Feeding the poor does not count.

cards.ask: Which count as the kaffara for killing by mistake?

options.text: Freeing a believing slave
Fasting two months in a row, if he cannot free a slave
Feeding sixty poor people
Fasting two months with breaks in between
Paying a ghurra

cards.source: عتق رقبة مؤمنة فإن لم يجد فصيام شهرين متتابعين ولا يجزئ فيها الإطعام
cards.why: Only freeing a believing slave, or else two months of fasting in a row. Feeding does not count.

cards.ask: Haris strikes a pregnant woman by mistake and she loses the stillborn child. She survives. What does Haris owe?
options: A full diya and a kaffara
source: فألقت جنينا ميتا فعليه غرة
ولا كفارة في الجنين
cards.why: A stillborn child brings a ghurra, and there is no kaffara for an unborn child.

lessons.title: Qasama: a body found and no killer known

cards.title: Fifty oaths
cards.ar: وإذا وجد القتيل في محلة ولا يعلم من قتله استحلف خمسون رجلا منهم يتخيرهم الولي: بالله ما قتلناه ولا علمنا له قاتلا فإذا حلفوا قضي على أهل المحلة بالدية
cards.en: Qasama is a set of oaths. If a slain man is found in a neighbourhood (mahalla) and no one knows who killed him, fifty of its men, chosen by the victim's family (the wali), each swear: "By Allah, we did not kill him, nor do we know his killer." Then the neighbourhood pays the diya.

cards.ask: How many men swear? Complete it.
cards.ar: استحلف ____ رجلا منهم
cards.source: استحلف خمسون رجلا منهم
cards.why: خمسون: fifty men of the neighbourhood swear.

cards.title: Not the family, and repeating the oaths
cards.ar: ولا يستحلف الولي ولا يقضي له بالجناية وإن لم يكمل أهل المحلة كررت الأيمان عليهم حتى يتم خمسون
cards.en: The victim's family do not swear, and are not given a judgement of the crime on their word. If the neighbourhood has fewer than fifty men, the oaths are repeated among them until there are fifty.

cards.ask: A body is found in a small neighbourhood with only 25 men. How is the qasama done?
options: The victim's family swear the other 25
cards.source: وإن لم يكمل أهل المحلة كررت الأيمان عليهم حتى يتم خمسون
cards.why: The oaths are repeated until they reach fifty: 25 men × 2.

cards.title: Who swears, and which body counts
cards.ar: ولا يدخل في القسامة صبي ولا مجنون ولا امرأة ولا عبد وإن وجد ميت لا أثر به فلا قسامة ولا دية وكذلك إن كان الدم يسيل من أنفه أو من دبره أو من فمه فإن كان يخرج من عينيه أو من أذنه فهو قتيل
cards.en: No child, insane person, woman or slave takes part in the qasama. If a dead body has no mark on it, there is no qasama and no diya. The same if blood only runs from the nose, the back passage or the mouth. But if blood comes from the eyes or ears, he counts as slain.

cards.ask: A body is found in a neighbourhood. Is there a qasama?
source: فإن كان يخرج من عينيه أو من أذنه فهو قتيل
وإن وجد ميت لا أثر به فلا قسامة ولا دية
وكذلك إن كان الدم يسيل من أنفه أو من دبره أو من فمه
cards.why: Blood from the eyes or ears means he was slain. No mark, or blood only from the nose or mouth, does not.

cards.title: A house, or an animal
cards.ar: وإذا وجد القتيل على دابة يسوقها رجل فالدية على عاقلته دون أهل المحلة وإن وجد القتيل في دار إنسان فالقسامة عليه والدية على عاقلته
cards.en: If the body is on an animal a man is driving, the diya is on his 'aqila, not the neighbourhood. If it is in a man's house, the qasama is on him, and the diya on his 'aqila.

cards.ask: A slain man is found inside Jabir's house. Who swears, and who pays the diya?
options: The victim's family swear; Jabir pays
cards.source: وإن وجد القتيل في دار إنسان فالقسامة عليه والدية على عاقلته
cards.why: In a man's house, the qasama is on him and the diya on his 'aqila.

cards.title: Owners, not tenants or buyers
cards.ar: ولا يدخل السكان في القسامة مع الملاك عند أبي حنيفة وهي على أهل الخطة دون المشترين ولو بقي منهم واحد
cards.en: Tenants do not swear along with the owners, in Abu Hanifa's view. The qasama is on the ahl al-khitta, the families first given the land, not on later buyers, even if only one of those families is left.

cards.ask: A body is found in an old quarter. Most houses were sold to newcomers, but one family of the first settlers (ahl al-khitta) remains. On whom is the qasama?
options: The one family of the first settlers
The newcomers who bought the houses
The tenants who live there now
cards.source: وهي على أهل الخطة دون المشترين ولو بقي منهم واحد
cards.why: It is on the ahl al-khitta, not the buyers, even if only one of them is left.

cards.title: Ships and mosques
cards.ar: وإن وجد القتيل في سفينة فالقسامة على من فيها من الركاب والملاحين وإن وجد القتيل في مسجد محلة فالقسامة على أهلها وإن وجد في الجامع أو الشارع الأعظم فلا قسامة فيه والدية على بيت المال
cards.en: On a ship, the qasama is on its passengers and crew. In a neighbourhood mosque, it is on the neighbourhood's people. In the great mosque (jami') or the main street there is no qasama, and the diya comes from the bayt al-mal (the public treasury).

cards.ask: Where the body is found: who answers for it?
source: فالقسامة على من فيها من الركاب والملاحين
وإن وجد القتيل في مسجد محلة فالقسامة على أهلها
وإن وجد في الجامع أو الشارع الأعظم فلا قسامة فيه والدية على بيت المال
cards.why: A ship and a local mosque fall on the people there. The great mosque and the main street belong to everyone, so the treasury pays.

cards.title: The wild, and the river
cards.ar: وإن وجد في برية ليس بقربها عمارة فهو هدر وإن وجد بين قريتين كان على أقربهما وإن وجد في وسط الفرات بمر به الماء فهو هدر فإن كان محتسبا بالشاطئ فهو على أقرب القرى من ذلك المكان
cards.en: In open wild land with no buildings near, the body is hadar: nothing is owed. Between two villages, it is on the nearer one. Floating in the middle of the Euphrates, it is hadar. But if it is caught at the bank, it is on the village nearest that place.

cards.ask: Where the body is found: who answers for it?
items: In wild land far from any buildings
source: فهو على أقرب القرى من ذلك المكان
وإن وجد بين قريتين كان على أقربهما
وإن وجد في برية ليس بقربها عمارة فهو هدر
وإن وجد في وسط الفرات بمر به الماء فهو هدر
cards.why: The bank and a place between villages fall on the nearest village. Wild land and mid-river are hadar.

cards.title: The family accuse someone
cards.ar: وإن ادعى الولي على واحد من أهل المحلة بعينه لم تسقط القسامة عنهم وإن ادعى على واحد من غيرهم سقطت عنهم القسامة
cards.en: If the family accuse one named man of the neighbourhood, the qasama on the neighbourhood still stands. If they accuse someone from outside it, the qasama falls from them.

cards.ask: A body is found in Bab al-Sham quarter. The family accuse a man from another town by name. What happens to the qasama on the quarter?
options: The accused swears fifty oaths instead
cards.source: وإن ادعى على واحد من غيرهم سقطت عنهم القسامة
cards.why: Accusing an outsider frees the neighbourhood from the qasama.

cards.title: Naming the killer
cards.ar: وإذا قال المستحلف: قتله فلان استحلف بالله ما قتلت ولا عرفت له قاتلا غير فلان وإذا شهد اثنان من أهل المحلة على رجل من غيرهم أنه قتله لم تقبل شهادتهما
cards.en: A man asked to swear who says "So-and-so killed him" swears: "By Allah, I did not kill him, and I know no killer of his but So-and-so." If two men of the neighbourhood testify that an outsider killed him, it is not accepted.

cards.ask: Which statement matches al-Quduri?
options: Two of its men cannot testify against an outsider
The women of the neighbourhood also swear the oaths
The victim's family swear the first oaths
source: وإذا شهد اثنان من أهل المحلة على رجل من غيرهم أنه قتله لم تقبل شهادتهما
ولا امرأة ولا عبد
ولا يستحلف الولي
cards.why: Their testimony is not accepted. Women do not swear, and the family never swear.

cards.title: The 'aqila is the diwan
cards.ar: الدية في شبه العمد والخطإ وكل دية وجبت بنفس القتل على العاقلة والعاقلة: أهل الديوان
cards.en: The diya for shibh 'amd and mistake, and every diya due by the killing itself, is on the 'aqila. The 'aqila are the people of the diwan: the register of soldiers who receive a yearly stipend from the state.

cards.title: Over three years
cards.ar: إن كان القاتل من أهل الديوان يؤخذ من عطاياهم في ثلاث سنين
cards.en: If the killer is in the diwan, it is taken from their stipends over three years. If he is not, his 'aqila is his tribe, and it is spread over them over three years: no one pays more than four dirhams a year. If the tribe is too small, the nearest tribes are added to them.

cards.ask: Amir is not in the diwan, so his tribe carries a diya for him. What is the most any one tribesman pays in a year?
cards.source: لا يزاد الواحد على أربعة دراهم في كل سنة
cards.why: No one pays more than four dirhams a year; if the tribe is too small, nearby tribes are added.

cards.ask: Over how long? Complete it.
cards.ar: فعاقلته قبيلته تقسط عليهم في ____
cards.source: فعاقلته قبيلته تقسط عليهم في ثلاث سنين
cards.why: ثلاث سنين: it is spread over three years.

cards.title: The killer pays too
cards.ar: ويدخل القاتل مع العاقلة فيكون فيما يؤدي مثل أحدهم
cards.en: The killer joins the 'aqila and pays the same as one of them.

cards.title: The freed man, and the smallest amount
cards.ar: وعاقلة المعتق قبيلة مولاه ومولى الموالاة يعقل عنه مولاه وقبيلته ولا تتحمل العاقلة أقل من نصف عشر الدية وتتحمل نصف العشر فصاعدا وما ينقص من ذلك فهو في مال الجاني
cards.en: A freed slave's 'aqila is his former master's tribe. A man with a pact of wala' has his mawla and the mawla's tribe as his 'aqila. The 'aqila do not carry less than a twentieth of the diya; they carry a twentieth or more. Anything less is paid from the wrongdoer's own wealth.

cards.ask: By mistake, Bassam causes an injury whose arsh is 3 camels. A full diya is 100 camels. Who pays?
cards.source: ولا تتحمل العاقلة أقل من نصف عشر الدية
cards.why: A twentieth of the diya is 5 camels. 3 is less, so the 'aqila do not carry it.

cards.ask: Mubarak, a freed slave, kills someone by mistake. Who is his 'aqila?
cards.source: وعاقلة المعتق قبيلة مولاه
cards.why: A freed man's 'aqila is the tribe of the one who freed him.

cards.title: What the 'aqila do not carry
cards.ar: ولا تعتقل العاقلة جناية العبد ولا تعقل الجناية التي اعترف بها الجاني إلا أن يصدقوه ولا تعقل ما لزم بالصلح وإذا جنى الحر على العبد جناية خطأ كانت على عاقلته
cards.en: The 'aqila do not carry a slave's crime, nor a crime the wrongdoer confessed to unless they believe him, nor what is owed by a settlement. If a free man harms a slave by mistake, it is on his 'aqila.

cards.ask: Do the 'aqila carry this?
items: A free man kills a slave by mistake
A mistaken killing, proven by witnesses
A crime done by a slave
A confession they do not believe
An amount agreed in a settlement
source: وإذا جنى الحر على العبد جناية خطأ كانت على عاقلته
وكل دية وجبت بنفس القتل على العاقلة
جناية العبد
ولا تعقل الجناية التي اعترف بها الجاني إلا أن يصدقوه ولا تعقل ما لزم بالصلح
cards.why: A free man's mistake, even against a slave, falls on the 'aqila. A slave's crime, an unbelieved confession and a settlement do not.

cards.title: Two ways to prove it
cards.ar: الزنا يثبت بالبينة والإقرار
cards.en: A hadd (plural hudud) is a fixed punishment that Allah has set for certain crimes. Zina means a man and a woman having relations without being married to each other. It is proved in only two ways: bayyina (evidence from witnesses) or iqrar (the person's own confession).

cards.ask: In how many ways is zina proved?
cards.source: الزنا يثبت بالبينة والإقرار
cards.why: Only two: bayyina (four witnesses) or iqrar (his own confession).

cards.ask: Which of these prove zina?

options.text: Four witnesses
Two witnesses
A confession made four times, in four sittings
A single confession

source: الزنا يثبت بالبينة والإقرار
فالبينة: أن تشهد أربعة من الشهود
أربع مرات في أربعة مجالس من مجالس المقر
cards.why: Zina is proved by four witnesses or by four confessions in four sittings. Two witnesses or one confession are not enough.

cards.title: Four witnesses
cards.ar: فالبينة: أن تشهد أربعة من الشهود على رجل أو امرأة بالزنا فيسألهم الإمام عن الزنا
cards.en: The evidence is four witnesses who testify against a man or a woman. The imam (the Muslim ruler, or the judge he appoints) then questions them closely.

cards.ask: Three men come to the judge and say they saw two people commit zina. Is that evidence enough?
options: Yes: three is more than two
cards.source: فالبينة: أن تشهد أربعة من الشهود على رجل أو امرأة بالزنا
cards.why: The evidence for zina is four witnesses. Three are not enough.

cards.title: The five questions
cards.ar: ما هو؟ وكيف هو؟ وأين زنى؟ وبمن زنى؟ ومتى زنى؟
cards.en: The imam asks the witnesses: What is it? How was it? Where did it happen? With whom? When?

cards.title: Checking the witnesses
cards.ar: وسأل القاضي عنهم فعدلوا في السر والعلانية حكم بشهادتهم
cards.en: The qadi (judge) also asks about the witnesses themselves. If people confirm, both in private and in public, that they are 'adl (honest and upright), he rules by their testimony.

cards.ask: Which questions does the imam ask the witnesses?

options.text: Where it happened
When it happened
With whom it happened
Why the witnesses were there
How much the accused earns

cards.source: ما هو؟ وكيف هو؟ وأين زنى؟ وبمن زنى؟ ومتى زنى؟
cards.why: He asks what, how, where, with whom and when. The witnesses' reasons or the person's wealth are not part of it.

cards.title: Confessing four times
cards.ar: والإقرار: أن يقر البالغ العاقل على نفسه بالزنا أربع مرات في أربعة مجالس من مجالس المقر كلما أقر رده القاضي
cards.en: A confession counts when an adult (baligh) of sound mind ('aqil) admits it against himself four times, in four separate sittings. Each time he confesses, the judge turns him away.

cards.ask: Complete al-Quduri's words on confession.
cards.ar: أربع مرات في أربعة ____ من مجالس المقر
cards.source: أربع مرات في أربعة مجالس من مجالس المقر
cards.why: مجالس: four confessions in four separate sittings.

cards.ask: Khalid, an adult of sound mind, confesses once to the judge and then goes home. Is the hadd due?
cards.source: أن يقر البالغ العاقل على نفسه بالزنا أربع مرات في أربعة مجالس
cards.why: A confession to zina must be made four times, in four different sittings. One is not enough.

cards.title: Questions after the fourth time
cards.ar: فإذا تم إقراره أربع مرات سأله الإمام عن الزنا: ما هو؟ وكيف هو؟ وأين زنى؟ وبمن زنى؟ فإذا بين ذلك لزمه الحد
cards.en: When he has confessed four times, the imam asks him what it was, how, where and with whom. Only when he explains all this clearly does the hadd become due.

cards.ask: A 12-year-old boy who has not reached puberty confesses four times in four sittings. What is the ruling?
options: No hadd: he is not an adult
The hadd: he said it four times
The hadd is due, but halved
cards.source: أن يقر البالغ العاقل على نفسه
cards.why: A confession only counts from someone who is baligh (adult) and 'aqil (sane). A child's confession brings no hadd.

cards.ask: Witnesses or confession?
items: Said four times in four sittings
The judge turns him away each time
Checked as upright in private and in public
source: فالبينة: أن تشهد أربعة من الشهود
ومتى زنى؟
فعدلوا في السر والعلانية
أربع مرات في أربعة مجالس من مجالس المقر كلما أقر رده القاضي
cards.why: Witnesses are four, checked as upright, and are asked 'when'. A confession is four times in four sittings, and the judge turns him away each time.

cards.title: If he is muhsan
cards.ar: فإن كان الزاني محصنا رجمه بالحجارة حتى يموت يخرجه إلى أرض فضاء
cards.en: A muhsan is a person who meets certain conditions, such as having been in a valid marriage (the next lesson lists them). If a muhsan commits zina, the hadd is rajm: stoning until death, carried out in open ground outside.

cards.title: Who begins
cards.ar: يبتدئ الشهود برجمه ثم الإمام ثم الناس فإن امتنع الشهود من الابتداء سقط الحد
cards.en: The witnesses must begin, then the imam, then the people. If the witnesses refuse to begin, the hadd falls away.

cards.ask: When the case was proved by witnesses, who begins, in order?
cards.source: يبتدئ الشهود برجمه ثم الإمام ثم الناس
cards.why: The witnesses begin, then the imam, then the people.

cards.ask: Four witnesses proved a case, but when the time comes they refuse to begin. What happens?
cards.source: فإن امتنع الشهود من الابتداء سقط الحد
cards.why: If the witnesses refuse to begin, the hadd is dropped.

cards.title: If he confessed
cards.ar: وإن كان مقرا ابتدأ الإمام ثم الناس ويغسل ويكفن ويصلي عليه
cards.en: If it was proved by his own confession, the imam begins, then the people. Afterwards he is washed, shrouded and the funeral prayer is prayed over him, like any Muslim.

cards.title: If he is not muhsan
cards.ar: وإن لم يكن محصنا وكان حرا فحده مائة جلدة يأمر الإمام بضربه بسوط لا ثمرة له ضربا متوسطا تنزع عنه ثيابه ويفرق الضرب على أعضائه إلا رأسه ووجهه وفرجه
cards.en: If he is not muhsan and is free, the hadd is 100 lashes, with a whip that has no knot at its end, struck with medium force. His clothes are taken off and the blows are spread over his body, avoiding the head, the face and the private parts. A slave got half: 50.

cards.ask: In al-Quduri's time, a slave who was not muhsan was found guilty of zina. How many lashes was the hadd?
cards.source: وإن كان عبدا جلده خمسين وكذلك الأمة
cards.why: A free person gets 100 lashes; a slave, man or woman, got half: 50.

cards.title: Taking back a confession
cards.ar: فإن رجع المقر عن إقراره قبل إقامة الحد عليه أو في وسطه قبل رجوعه وخلي سبيله
cards.en: If the one who confessed takes it back before the hadd, or even in the middle of it, his taking back is accepted and he is let go.

cards.title: The imam prompts him
cards.ar: ويستحب للإمام أن يلقن المقر الرجوع ويقول له: لعلك لمست أو قبلت
cards.en: It is mustahabb (recommended) for the imam to prompt the one who confessed to take it back, saying: "Perhaps you only touched her, or kissed her."

cards.ask: Hamid confessed four times. Halfway through his lashes he says, "I take it back." What happens?
options: It is accepted; he is let go
He gets extra lashes for lying
cards.source: فإن رجع المقر عن إقراره قبل إقامة الحد عليه أو في وسطه قبل رجوعه وخلي سبيله
cards.why: Taking back a confession is accepted even in the middle of the hadd, and he is set free.

cards.ask: Before the hadd, what is it mustahabb (recommended) for the imam to do with someone who confesses?
options: Hint that he may take it back
Urge him to repeat it quickly
Have it written and signed by him
cards.source: ويستحب للإمام أن يلقن المقر الرجوع ويقول له: لعلك لمست أو قبلت
cards.why: The imam is encouraged to prompt him to take it back, offering him a lesser explanation.

cards.title: Men and women
cards.ar: والرجل والمرأة في ذلك سواء غير أن المرأة لا تنزع عنها ثيابها إلا الفرو والحشو وإن حفر لها في الرجم جاز
cards.en: Men and women are the same in all this, except that a woman's clothes are not removed, only a fur or a padded garment. In rajm, a pit may be dug for her, to keep her covered.

cards.ask: Which are true of the punishment for zina?

options.text: A free person who is not muhsan gets 100 lashes
The blows avoid the head, face and private parts
A woman keeps her clothes on, except fur or padding
The whip should have a knot at its end
Someone who takes back his confession mid-way still gets the rest

source: فحده مائة جلدة
إلا رأسه ووجهه وفرجه
غير أن المرأة لا تنزع عنها ثيابها إلا الفرو والحشو
بسوط لا ثمرة له
أو في وسطه قبل رجوعه وخلي سبيله
cards.why: 100 lashes, sparing the head, face and private parts, and a woman stays clothed. The whip has no knot, and taking back a confession mid-way is accepted.

lessons.title: Ihsan, witnesses who withdraw, and delays

cards.title: Only with the imam's permission
cards.ar: ولا يقيم المولى الحد على عبده إلا بإذن الإمام
cards.en: In al-Quduri's time, a master could not carry out a hadd on his slave himself, only with the imam's permission. Hudud belong to the ruler, not to private people.

cards.title: If a witness withdraws
cards.ar: وإذا رجع أحد الشهود بعد الحكم وقبل الرجم ضربوا الحد وسقط الرجم فإن رجع بعد الرجم حد الراجع وحده وضمن ربع الدية
cards.en: If one witness takes back his testimony after the ruling but before the stoning, all of them get the hadd for false accusation, and the stoning is dropped. If he takes it back after the stoning, only he gets the hadd, and he pays a quarter of the diya (blood money).

cards.ask: After a stoning, one of the four witnesses says, "I lied." What is the ruling?
options: Hadd for him alone, and a quarter diya
All four get the hadd, and pay the diya
Nothing: the stoning is already done
cards.source: فإن رجع بعد الرجم حد الراجع وحده وضمن ربع الدية
cards.why: After the stoning, only the one who withdrew is punished, and he pays a quarter of the blood money, since he was one of four.

cards.title: What makes someone muhsan
cards.ar: وشرط إحصان الرجم: أن يكون حرا بالغا عاقلا مسلما قد تزوج امرأة نكاحا صحيحا ودخل بها وهما على صفة الإحصان
cards.en: Ihsan for stoning means being free, adult, sane and Muslim, and having married with a valid nikah (marriage contract) and lived with the spouse as husband and wife, both of them having these qualities at the time.

cards.ask: Which are conditions of ihsan for stoning?

options.text: Being free
Being Muslim
A valid marriage that was consummated
Having children
Being over forty

cards.source: أن يكون حرا بالغا عاقلا مسلما قد تزوج امرأة نكاحا صحيحا ودخل بها
cards.why: Free, adult, sane, Muslim and a valid, consummated marriage. Children and age are not conditions.

cards.title: Not both
cards.ar: ولا يجمع في المحصن بين الجلد والرجم ولا يجمع في البكر بين الجلد والنفي إلا أن يرى الإمام ذلك مصلحة فيغربه على قدر ما يراه
cards.en: A muhsan is not given both lashes and stoning. A bikr (one who has not been married) is not given both lashes and nafy (exile from the town), unless the imam sees benefit in it; then he exiles him for as long as he thinks right.

cards.ask: Rashid is muhsan, and his zina is proved by four witnesses. What is his hadd?
cards.source: ولا يجمع في المحصن بين الجلد والرجم
cards.why: A muhsan is stoned. Lashes and stoning are never given together.

cards.title: The sick
cards.ar: زنى المريض وحده الرجم رجم وإن كان حده الجلد لم يجلد حتى يبرأ
cards.en: If a sick person's hadd is stoning, it is carried out. If it is lashes, he is not lashed until he recovers, so the lashes do not kill him.

cards.title: The pregnant woman
cards.ar: وإذا زنت الحامل لم تحد حتى تضع حملها فإن كان حدها الجلد فحتى تتعالى من نفسها وإذا كان حدها الرجم رجمت
cards.en: A pregnant woman is not given the hadd until she gives birth, to protect the baby. If her hadd is lashes, they wait further until she has recovered from the birth.

cards.ask: Carried out now, or wait?
items: A sick person whose hadd is stoning
A sick person whose hadd is lashes
A pregnant woman before she gives birth
A woman just after giving birth, whose hadd is lashes
source: زنى المريض وحده الرجم رجم وإن كان حده الجلد لم يجلد حتى يبرأ
وإذا زنت الحامل لم تحد حتى تضع حملها فإن كان حدها الجلد فحتى تتعالى من نفسها
cards.why: Lashes wait for the sick to recover and for a mother to recover from birth; a pregnant woman always waits until the birth.

cards.title: Old testimony
cards.ar: وإذا شهد الشهود بحد متقادم لم يقطعهم عن إقامته بعدهم عن الإمام لم تقبل شهادتهم إلا في حد القذف خاصة
cards.en: If witnesses testify about an old crime (mutaqadim), and nothing like being far from the imam kept them from coming sooner, their testimony is not accepted, except for the hadd of qadhf (false accusation) only.

cards.ask: Four men lived near the judge, but waited two years before testifying to a zina they saw. Is their testimony accepted?
cards.source: وإذا شهد الشهود بحد متقادم لم يقطعهم عن إقامته بعدهم عن الإمام لم تقبل
cards.why: Old testimony with no excuse for the delay is not accepted for zina.

cards.ask: Which are true of ihsan and the witnesses to zina?

options.text: If only three witnesses come, they themselves get the hadd
Late testimony is still accepted for qadhf
A pregnant woman waits until she gives birth
A muhsan gets lashes and then stoning
A master could carry out a hadd on his slave without the imam

source: وإن نقص عدد الشهود عن أربعة حدوا
إلا في حد القذف خاصة
وإذا زنت الحامل لم تحد حتى تضع حملها
ولا يجمع في المحصن بين الجلد والرجم
ولا يقيم المولى الحد على عبده إلا بإذن الإمام
cards.why: Fewer than four witnesses are punished, qadhf is the exception for late testimony, and a pregnant woman waits. Lashes and stoning are never combined, and only the imam carries out hudud.

cards.title: Short of zina
cards.ar: ومن وطئ أجنبية فيما دون الفرج
cards.en: If a man is intimate with a woman he is not married to, but it stops short of zina, there is no hadd. He gets ta'zir instead: a lighter punishment that the judge chooses.

cards.title: His son's property
cards.ar: ولا حد على من وطئ جارية ولده وولد ولده وإن قال: علمت أنها علي حرام
cards.en: In al-Quduri's time there were slave-women (jariya). A father who had relations with his son's or grandson's slave-woman got no hadd, even if he said he knew it was haram. A father has a kind of claim on his child's property, and that doubt (shubha) removes the hadd.

cards.ask: In al-Quduri's time, Zayd had relations with his son's slave-woman, saying "I knew it was haram." What was the ruling?
options: No hadd: a doubt removes it
The hadd, as he knew it was haram
cards.source: ولا حد على من وطئ جارية ولده وولد ولده وإن قال: علمت أنها علي حرام
cards.why: A father has a kind of claim on his son's property. That doubt removes the hadd, even if he knew.

cards.title: His father's property
cards.ar: وإذا وطئ جارية أبيه أو أمه أو زوجته أو وطئ العبد جارية مولاه وقال: علمت أنها علي حرام حد
cards.en: But with his father's, mother's or wife's slave-woman, or a slave with his master's slave-woman, if he says he knew it was haram, he gets the hadd. A son has no such claim on his parents' property.

cards.ask: In al-Quduri's time: a man with this slave-woman says "I knew it was haram". Hadd, or no hadd?
source: ولا حد على من وطئ جارية ولده وولد ولده
وإذا وطئ جارية أبيه أو أمه أو زوجته
وقال: علمت أنها علي حرام حد
cards.why: A father has a claim on his child's property, which makes a doubt. A son has no such claim on his parents' or his wife's property.

cards.title: The wrong bride
cards.ar: ومن زفت إليه غير امرأته وقالت النساء: إنها زوجتك فوطئها فلا حد عليه وعليه المهر
cards.en: If on his wedding night a woman who is not his wife is brought to him, and the women say "She is your wife," there is no hadd on him, since he was told. He must pay her the mahr (the marriage gift a husband pays).

cards.ask: On Yusuf's wedding night the women of the family bring a bride to him and say, "This is your wife." Later it turns out she was a different woman. What is the ruling?
options: No hadd, and he owes her the mahr
The hadd, since she was not his wife
cards.source: ومن زفت إليه غير امرأته وقالت النساء: إنها زوجتك فوطئها فلا حد عليه وعليه المهر
cards.why: He relied on what he was told, so there is no hadd, but he must pay her the mahr.

cards.title: Found in his bed
cards.ar: ومن وجد امرأة على فراشه فوطئها فعليه الحد
cards.en: If a man finds a woman in his bed and has relations with her, he gets the hadd. Finding someone there is no proof she is his wife; nobody told him so.

cards.ask: Why does the man in the bed get the hadd, but the man with the wrong bride does not?
options: She was announced as his wife
The groom pays the mahr, so no hadd
source: وقالت النساء: إنها زوجتك
ومن وجد امرأة على فراشه فوطئها فعليه الحد
cards.why: The groom was told "She is your wife", which is a real reason to believe it. Simply finding a woman in bed is not.

cards.title: A marriage he may not make
cards.ar: ومن تزوج امرأة لا يحل له نكاحها فوطئها لم يجب عليه الحد
cards.en: If a man marries a woman whom he is not allowed to marry, and lives with her, the hadd is not due. The marriage contract creates a doubt, and a doubt removes the hadd.

cards.title: Outside Muslim rule
cards.ar: ومن زنى في دار الحرب أو دار البغي ثم خرج إلينا لم نقم عليه الحد
cards.en: Dar al-harb is land at war with the Muslims, outside their rule. Dar al-baghy is land held by rebels. If someone commits zina there and then comes to Muslim lands, the hadd is not carried out, because the imam had no power there.

cards.ask: A Muslim committed zina while in dar al-harb, then returned home. What does the judge do?
options: Carries out the hadd as normal
cards.source: ومن زنى في دار الحرب أو دار البغي ثم خرج إلينا لم نقم عليه الحد
cards.why: A crime done where the imam had no rule does not bring the hadd later.

cards.ask: Hadd, or no hadd?
items: The wrong bride, announced as his wife
A woman he found in his bed
A woman he married though he was not allowed to
Zina in dar al-baghy, then he comes home
Intimacy with a stranger, short of zina
source: فلا حد عليه وعليه المهر
ومن وجد امرأة على فراشه فوطئها فعليه الحد
ومن تزوج امرأة لا يحل له نكاحها فوطئها لم يجب عليه الحد
ومن زنى في دار الحرب أو دار البغي
ومن وطئ أجنبية فيما دون الفرج
cards.why: An announced bride, a marriage contract, a place outside the imam's rule, or stopping short of zina removes the hadd. The woman in his bed does not.

cards.title: Caught with the smell
cards.ar: ومن شرب الخمر فأخذ وريحها موجود فشهد الشهود بذلك عليه
cards.en: Khamr is wine. Whoever drinks it and is caught while its smell is still on him, and witnesses testify to it, gets the hadd.

cards.ask: Majid drank wine. Two days later, when there was no smell left, he confessed. Is he given the hadd?
cards.source: وإن أقر بعد ذهاب رائحتها لم يحد
cards.why: If the confession comes after the smell has gone, there is no hadd.

cards.title: Drunk on nabidh
cards.ar: ومن سكر من النبيذ حد
cards.en: Nabidh is a drink made by soaking dates or raisins in water. Whoever gets drunk from nabidh gets the hadd.

cards.title: What is not enough
cards.ar: ولا حد على من وجد منه رائحة الخمر أو تقيأها ولا يحد السكران حتى يعلم أنه سكر من النبيذ وشربه طوعا ولا يحد حتى يزول عنه السكر
cards.en: There is no hadd just for smelling of wine or vomiting it up. A drunk person is not given the hadd until it is known he got drunk from nabidh and drank it willingly. And the hadd waits until he is sober again.

cards.ask: Which, on their own, do NOT bring the hadd?

options.text: Smelling of wine
Vomiting wine
Being forced to drink
Being caught drunk on nabidh he drank by choice
Two men testifying while the smell is still there

source: ولا حد على من وجد منه رائحة الخمر أو تقيأها
وشربه طوعا
ومن سكر من النبيذ حد
فأخذ وريحها موجود فشهد الشهود بذلك عليه
cards.why: A smell or vomit alone is not proof, and drinking must be willing. Choosing to get drunk on nabidh, or witnesses with the smell present, brings the hadd.

cards.title: Eighty lashes
cards.ar: وحد الخمر والسكر في الحد ثمانون سوطا يفرق على بدنه كما ذكرنا في الزنا وإن كان عبدا فحده أربعون سوطا
cards.en: The hadd for drinking wine, or for getting drunk, is 80 lashes, spread over the body as with zina. In al-Quduri's time a slave got 40.

cards.ask: A free man is proved to have drunk wine. How many lashes is his hadd?
cards.source: وحد الخمر والسكر في الحد ثمانون سوطا
cards.why: The hadd for drink is 80 lashes for a free person. 100 is for zina; 40 was for a slave.

cards.ask: Complete the rule: when is a drunk person given the hadd?
cards.ar: ولا يحد حتى يزول عنه ____
cards.source: ولا يحد حتى يزول عنه السكر
cards.why: السكر: he waits until he is no longer drunk, so he feels and understands the punishment.

cards.title: How drinking is proved
cards.ar: ويثبت الشرب بشهادة شاهدين وبإقراره مرة واحدة ولا تقبل فيه شهادة النساء مع الرجال
cards.en: Drinking is proved by two witnesses, or by confessing just once. The testimony of women together with men is not accepted for it.

cards.ask: One man and two women testify that Rami drank wine. Is it proved?
options: Yes: a man and two women equal two men
Yes: three witnesses are more than two
cards.source: ولا تقبل فيه شهادة النساء مع الرجال
cards.why: For drinking, only two men count as witnesses. Women's testimony with men is not accepted in hudud.

cards.ask: Sami confesses once that he drank, then takes it back. What is the ruling?
options: The hadd, since one confession is enough
cards.source: بشرب الخمر أو السكر ثم رجع لم يحد
cards.why: Whoever confesses to drinking and then takes it back is not given the hadd.

cards.ask: Hadd, or no hadd?
items: Caught with the smell on him, and two men testify
Confesses after the smell has gone
Got drunk on nabidh by his own choice
Confesses once, then takes it back
source: فأخذ وريحها موجود فشهد الشهود بذلك عليه
وإن أقر بعد ذهاب رائحتها لم يحد
ولا حد على من وجد منه رائحة الخمر
ومن سكر من النبيذ حد
ثم رجع لم يحد
cards.why: Witnesses with the smell present, or drunkenness from nabidh by choice, bring the hadd. A late confession, a smell alone, or a confession taken back do not.

cards.title: What qadhf is
cards.ar: إذا قذف رجل رجلا محصنا أو امرأة محصنة بصريح الزنا وطالب المقذوف بالحد حده الحاكم ثمانين سوطا إن كان حرا
cards.en: Qadhf is accusing someone openly and clearly of zina. If a man accuses a muhsan man or woman, and the accused person demands the hadd, the ruler lashes the accuser 80 times, if he is free.

cards.ask: Tariq openly accuses Ahmad, a chaste Muslim, of zina. Ahmad decides not to demand anything. Does the ruler lash Tariq?
cards.source: وطالب المقذوف بالحد حده الحاكم
cards.why: The hadd of qadhf is given when the accused person demands it.

cards.title: How it is given
cards.ar: يفرق على أعضائه ولا يجرد عن ثيابه غير أنه ينزع عنه الفرو والحشو وإن كان عبدا جلده أربعين
cards.en: The lashes are spread over his body. His clothes are not taken off, only a fur or a padded garment. In al-Quduri's time a slave got 40.

cards.title: Ihsan in qadhf
cards.ar: والإحصان: أن يكون المقذوف حرا عاقلا بالغا مسلما عفيفا عن فعل الزنا
cards.en: Here muhsan means something a little different: the accused person is free, sane, adult, Muslim, and chaste ('afif), never having done zina. Marriage is not a condition here.

cards.ask: For qadhf, which must be true of the accused person?

options.text: Free
Adult and sane
Muslim
Chaste, never having done zina
Married

cards.source: والإحصان: أن يكون المقذوف حرا عاقلا بالغا مسلما عفيفا عن فعل الزنا
cards.why: Free, sane, adult, Muslim and chaste. Marriage is needed for the ihsan of stoning, not here.

cards.title: Denying someone's father
cards.ar: ومن نفى نسب غيره فقال: لست لأبيك أو: يا ابن الزانية وأمه ميتة محصنة وطالب الابن بالحد حد القاذف ولا يطالب بحد القذف للميت إلا من يقع القدح في نسبه بقذفه
cards.en: Saying "You are not your father's son" is an accusation against the mother. If she has died and was muhsan, and her son demands the hadd, the accuser is lashed. For a dead person, only someone whose family line is hurt by the accusation may demand it.

cards.ask: Someone says to Umar, "You are not your father's son." Umar's mother has died; she was a chaste Muslim woman. Who may demand the hadd?
options: Only the judge, on her behalf
cards.source: وطالب الابن بالحد حد القاذف ولا يطالب بحد القذف للميت إلا من يقع القدح في نسبه بقذفه
cards.why: For a dead person, the one whose lineage is attacked, here her son, may demand the hadd.

cards.title: Any son may demand
cards.ar: وإن كان المقذوف محصنا جاز لابنه الكافر والعبد أن يطالب بالحد وليس للعبد أن يطالب مولاه بقذف أمه الحرة
cards.en: If the accused was muhsan, even her son who is not Muslim, or who was a slave, may demand the hadd. But in al-Quduri's time a slave could not demand it against his own master for accusing his free mother.

cards.ask: Faisal confesses that he accused someone falsely, then takes his confession back. What is the ruling?
options: No hadd: he took it back
cards.source: وإن أقر بالقذف ثم رجع لم يقبل رجوعه
cards.why: Unlike zina and drinking, taking back a confession of qadhf is not accepted, because it is another person's right.

cards.title: Words that are not qadhf
cards.ar: ومن قال لعربي: يا نبطئ لم يحد ومن قال لرجل: يا ابن ماء السماء فليس بقاذف وإذا نسبه إلى عمه أو خاله أو زوج أمه فليس بقاذف
cards.en: Calling an Arab "O Nabati" (a non-Arab farming people) brings no hadd. "O son of the water of the sky" is a phrase of praise, not an accusation. Calling a man the son of his uncle or his stepfather is not qadhf either, since people call them "father".

cards.title: When the accuser is not lashed
cards.ar: ومن وطئ وطئا حراما في غير ملكه لم يحد قاذفه والملاعنة بولد لا يحد قاذفها
cards.en: If the accused person really did have unlawful relations, he is not chaste, so his accuser is not lashed. Nor is the accuser of a woman whose child was disowned by li'an (the sworn oaths between husband and wife).

cards.ask: Qadhf with a hadd, or not?
items: "You are not your father's son" said to a man whose late mother was chaste
Calling a man "son of the water of the sky"
Openly accusing a chaste Muslim woman of zina, and she demands it
Calling a man his uncle's son
source: ومن نفى نسب غيره فقال: لست لأبيك
ومن قال لعربي: يا نبطئ لم يحد
يا ابن ماء السماء فليس
أو امرأة محصنة بصريح الزنا وطالب المقذوف بالحد
وإذا نسبه إلى عمه أو خاله أو زوج أمه فليس بقاذف
cards.why: A clear accusation of zina, or denying someone's father, is qadhf. Calling an Arab a Nabati, a phrase of praise, or naming an uncle as father is not.

lessons.title: Ta'zir, and what follows a hadd

cards.title: When it is ta'zir
cards.ar: ومن قذف عبدا أو أمة أو كافرا بالزنا أو قذف مسلما بغير الزنا فقال: يا فاسق أو يا كافر أو يا خبيث عزر
cards.en: Ta'zir is a lighter punishment the judge decides. It is given to someone who accuses a slave or a non-Muslim of zina, or who insults a Muslim with words like "O fasiq (sinner)", "O kafir (disbeliever)" or "O khabith (vile one)".

cards.title: Words with no ta'zir
cards.ar: وإن قال: يا حمار أو يا خنزير لم يعزر
cards.en: If he says "O donkey" or "O pig", there is no ta'zir, because everyone knows it is untrue, so it does not damage the person's honour.

cards.ask: Ta'zir, or none?
source: ومن قذف عبدا أو أمة أو كافرا بالزنا
فقال: يا فاسق أو يا كافر أو يا خبيث عزر
وإن قال: يا حمار أو يا خنزير لم يعزر
cards.why: Insults that harm honour, like fasiq or khabith, and accusing a non-Muslim, bring ta'zir. "Donkey" and "pig" do not.

cards.title: How much
cards.ar: والتعزير: أكثره تسعة وثلاثون سوطا وأقله ثلاث جلدات
cards.en: The most ta'zir can be is 39 lashes, and the least is 3. It always stays below the smallest hadd. Note: Abu Yusuf said it can reach 75.

cards.ask: Following Abu Hanifa's rule in al-Quduri, what is the most a judge can give as ta'zir?
cards.source: والتعزير: أكثره تسعة وثلاثون سوطا
cards.why: Ta'zir is at most 39 lashes, below the 40 of the smallest hadd.

cards.ask: A judge gives Imran ta'zir. Can he add prison to the lashes?
options: Yes, if the imam sees fit
Only for a hadd, not ta'zir
cards.source: فإن رأى الإمام أن يضم إلى الضرب في التعزير الحبس فعل
cards.why: If the imam thinks prison should be added to the lashes in ta'zir, he may do so.

cards.title: Which is struck hardest
cards.ar: وأشد الضرب التعزير ثم حد الزنا ثم حد الشرب ثم حد القذف
cards.en: The hardest blows are in ta'zir (since its number is small), then the hadd of zina, then of drinking, then of qadhf.

cards.ask: Put these from the hardest blows to the lightest.
cards.source: وأشد الضرب التعزير ثم حد الزنا ثم حد الشرب ثم حد القذف
cards.why: Ta'zir, then zina, then drinking, then qadhf.

cards.title: If he dies
cards.ar: ومن حده الإمام أو عزره فمات فدمه هدر
cards.en: If someone dies after the imam gives him a hadd or ta'zir, his blood is hadar: nobody owes diya (blood money) for it, since the imam did what he was required to.

cards.title: Testimony after qadhf
cards.ar: وإذا حد المسلم في القذف سقطت شهادته وإن تاب وإن حد الكافر في القذف ثم أسلم قبلت شهادته
cards.en: A Muslim given the hadd for qadhf can never be a witness again, even if he repents. A non-Muslim given it who then becomes Muslim is accepted as a witness, since Islam starts him afresh.

cards.ask: Jamal, a Muslim, was lashed for qadhf. Years later he has sincerely repented. Can he be a witness in court?
options: Yes, once some years have passed
cards.source: وإذا حد المسلم في القذف سقطت شهادته وإن تاب
cards.why: A Muslim lashed for qadhf loses his testimony for good, even after repenting.

cards.ask: Which are true of ta'zir and the hadd?

options.text: Ta'zir is at least three lashes
If someone dies from a hadd, no diya is owed
A non-Muslim lashed for qadhf who becomes Muslim can testify
Saying "O donkey" brings ta'zir
The hadd of qadhf is struck harder than ta'zir

source: وأقله ثلاث جلدات
فمات فدمه هدر
وإن حد الكافر في القذف ثم أسلم قبلت شهادته
وإن قال: يا حمار أو يا خنزير لم يعزر
وأشد الضرب التعزير
cards.why: Ta'zir is three lashes at least, a death from a hadd is hadar, and Islam restores a non-Muslim's testimony. "Donkey" brings nothing, and ta'zir is struck hardest.

cards.title: The first: khamr
cards.ar: الأشربة المحرمة أربعة: الخمر وهي: عصير العنب
cards.en: Four drinks are haram. The first is khamr: grape juice that has fermented, become strong and thrown up froth.

cards.title: The second: half-cooked juice
cards.ar: والعصير إذا طبخ حتى ذهب أقل من ثلثيه
cards.en: The second is grape juice that was cooked, but less than two-thirds of it boiled away.

cards.ask: Ali boils 3 litres of grape juice down to 2 litres, and it later becomes strong. What is the ruling?
options: Halal, if he drinks only a little
cards.source: والعصير إذا طبخ حتى ذهب أقل من ثلثيه
cards.why: Only one-third boiled away, which is less than two-thirds, so it is one of the four forbidden drinks.

cards.title: The third and fourth: soaked dates and raisins
cards.ar: ونقيع التمر والزبيب إذا اشتد
cards.en: The third and fourth are naqi': dates, or raisins, soaked raw in water until the drink becomes strong.

cards.ask: How many drinks does al-Quduri count as haram?
cards.source: الأشربة المحرمة أربعة
cards.why: Four: khamr, grape juice cooked by less than two-thirds, and strong soaked dates or raisins.

cards.title: Lightly cooked nabidh
cards.ar: ونبيذ التمر والزبيب إذا طبخ كل واحد منهما أدنى طبخ حلال وإن اشتد إذا شرب منه ما يغلب في ظنه أنه لا يسكره من غير لهو ولا طرب
cards.en: Nabidh of dates or raisins that has been cooked, even a little, is halal even if it becomes strong, but only an amount he is sure will not make him drunk, and not for fun or partying.

cards.title: Other drinks
cards.ar: ولا بأس بالخليطين ونبيذ العسل والتين والحنطة والشعير والذرة حلال وإن لم يطبخ
cards.en: There is no harm in khalitayn (a drink of two fruits mixed, like dates and raisins). Nabidh made from honey, figs, wheat, barley or millet is halal even if not cooked.

cards.ask: Which of these drinks is halal even if it was never cooked?
options: Grape juice cooked down by less than two-thirds
cards.source: ونبيذ العسل والتين والحنطة والشعير والذرة حلال وإن لم يطبخ
cards.why: Nabidh of honey, figs, wheat, barley or millet is halal uncooked. The other two are among the four forbidden.

cards.title: Two-thirds gone
cards.ar: وعصير العنب إذا طبخ حتى ذهب منه ثلثاه وبقي ثلثه حلال وإن اشتد
cards.en: Grape juice cooked until two-thirds of it is gone and one-third is left is halal, even if it becomes strong.

cards.ask: Huda boils 3 litres of grape juice until 1 litre is left. What is the ruling on the drink?
options: Haram: it is cooked grape juice
cards.source: وعصير العنب إذا طبخ حتى ذهب منه ثلثاه وبقي ثلثه حلال
cards.why: From 3 litres to 1, two-thirds has boiled away, so it is halal.

cards.title: Any container
cards.ar: ولا بأس بالانتباذ في الدباء والحنتم والمزفت والنقير
cards.en: There is no harm in making nabidh in a dried gourd, a green clay jar, a pitch-lined pot or a hollowed tree stump.

cards.title: Wine turned to vinegar
cards.ar: وإذا تخللت الخمر حلت سواء صارت خلا بنفسها أو بشيء طرح فيها ولا يكره تخليلها
cards.en: If wine turns into vinegar (khall), it becomes halal, whether it turned by itself or because something was put in it. Turning wine into vinegar is not disliked.

cards.ask: Musa puts salt in a jar of wine and it turns into vinegar. May the vinegar be used?
options: No: he changed it on purpose
Only if it turned by itself
cards.source: سواء صارت خلا بنفسها أو بشيء طرح فيها
cards.why: Wine that becomes vinegar is halal, whether by itself or because something was added.

cards.ask: Which of these are among the four forbidden drinks?

options.text: Grape wine (khamr)
Grape juice boiled until one-third is left
Grape juice cooked until less than two-thirds is gone
Nabidh of honey
Raw-soaked dates that became strong
Vinegar made from wine

source: الأشربة المحرمة أربعة: الخمر
والعصير إذا طبخ حتى ذهب أقل من ثلثيه
ونقيع التمر والزبيب إذا اشتد
حتى ذهب منه ثلثاه وبقي ثلثه حلال
ونبيذ العسل
وإذا تخللت الخمر حلت
cards.why: Khamr, juice cooked by less than two-thirds and strong soaked dates are among the four. Juice boiled down to a third, honey nabidh and vinegar from wine are halal.

lessons.title: When theft brings cutting
lessons.arabic: إذا سرق العاقل البالغ عشرة دراهم

cards.title: The rule of theft
cards.ar: أو ما قيمته عشرة دراهم مضروبة أو غير مضروبة من حرز لا شبهة فيه وجب عليه القطع
cards.en: If a sane adult steals ten dirhams (silver coins), or something worth ten dirhams, minted or not, from a hirz (a place where property is kept safe), with no shubha (doubt about his right to it), then qat' is due: cutting off the hand. Ten dirhams is the nisab, the least amount for this hadd.

cards.ask: Which are conditions for cutting?

options.text: The thief is sane and adult
It is worth at least ten dirhams
It was taken from a hirz
There is no doubt about his right to it
It happened at night

source: إذا سرق العاقل البالغ عشرة
أو ما قيمته عشرة دراهم
من حرز لا شبهة فيه وجب عليه القطع
cards.why: Sane, adult, ten dirhams, from a hirz, with no doubt. The time of day does not matter.

cards.ask: An adult steals 8 dirhams from a locked shop. Is his hand cut?
cards.source: أو ما قيمته عشرة دراهم مضروبة أو غير مضروبة من حرز لا شبهة فيه وجب عليه القطع
cards.why: The nisab of theft is ten dirhams. Eight is less, so there is no cutting.

cards.title: Free and slave alike
cards.ar: والعبد والحر في القطع سواء
