cards.en: With one daughter, she gets a half and the rest goes to the son's sons and their sisters, two to one. In the same way, what is left after one full sister's share goes to the father's sons and daughters, two to one.

cards.ask: Musa leaves 1,200 dirhams: one daughter, one son's son and one son's daughter. What does each get?
cards.source: فللبنت النصف والباقي لبني الابن وأخواتهم للذكر مثل حظ الأنثيين
cards.why: The daughter takes half (600). The 600 left is shared two to one: 400 to the son's son and 200 to the son's daughter.

cards.ask: Salma dies with no children or parents, leaving 600 dirhams: one full sister, one half-brother and one half-sister from her father. What does the half-brother get?
cards.source: وكذلك الفاضل عن فرض الأخت من الأب والأم لبني الأب وبنات الأب للذكر مثل حظ الأنثيين
cards.why: The full sister takes half (300). The 300 left goes two to one: 200 to the half-brother and 100 to the half-sister.

cards.title: A cousin who is also a half-brother
cards.ar: ومن ترك ابني عم أحدهما أخ الأم فللأخ للأم السدس والباقي
cards.en: If someone leaves two sons of an 'amm (cousins), and one of them is also his half-brother through the mother, that one first gets a sixth as a maternal half-brother. The rest is then shared between the two cousins.

cards.ask: Tamim leaves 1,200 dirhams and two cousins, Rafi and Hadi. Hadi is also his half-brother through the mother. What does each get?
cards.source: ومن ترك ابني عم أحدهما أخ الأم فللأخ للأم السدس والباقي
cards.why: Hadi first takes a sixth (200). The 1,000 left is shared between the two cousins: 500 each. So Hadi has 700 and Rafi 500.

cards.title: The mushtaraka case
cards.ar: والمشركة: أن تترك المرأة زوجا وأما - أو جدة - وأختين من أم وأخا لأب وأم فللزوج النصف وللأم السدس ولولد الأم الثلث ولا شيء للأخوة من الأب والأم
cards.en: The mushtaraka case: a woman leaves her husband, her mother (or a grandmother), two half-sisters through the mother, and a full brother. The husband gets a half, the mother a sixth, the mother's children a third, and the full brother gets nothing.

cards.ask: Huda leaves 1,200 dirhams: her husband, her mother, two half-sisters through the mother, and a full brother. What does the full brother get?
options: A share of the third with his half-sisters
cards.source: فللزوج النصف وللأم السدس ولولد الأم الثلث ولا شيء للأخوة من الأب والأم
cards.why: The husband takes 600, the mother 200 and the half-sisters 400. Nothing is left, and al-Quduri gives the full brother nothing.

cards.ask: Nabil dies with no children, leaving his mother, his father and one brother. What is his mother's share?
source: بالولد أو بأخوين
والثلث: للأم إذا لم يكن للميت ولد ولا ولد ابن ولا اثنان من الإخوة والأخوات فصاعدا
cards.why: It takes a child or two brothers to bring the mother down to a sixth. With one brother she keeps her third.

lessons.title: Giving back the surplus, and special cases

cards.title: Radd: giving back the surplus
cards.ar: باب الرد والفاضل عن فرض ذوي السهام إذا لم يكن عصبة مردود عليهم بمقدار سهامهم إلا على الزوجين
cards.en: Radd means giving back. If the fixed shares do not use up the estate and there is no 'asaba, what is left is given back to the share-holders in proportion to their shares. But nothing is given back to a husband or wife.

cards.ask: What is radd?
options: Giving the surplus back to the share-holders
Raising the base when shares are too many
The freer taking what is left
cards.source: والفاضل عن فرض ذوي السهام إذا لم يكن عصبة مردود عليهم بمقدار سهامهم
cards.why: Radd gives what is left back to those with fixed shares, in proportion. Raising the base is 'awl.

cards.ask: Sumayya dies, leaving her mother and a daughter, and 800 dirhams. There is no 'asaba. What does each get in the end?
options: Mother 133, daughter 400, the rest to no one
cards.source: مردود عليهم بمقدار سهامهم
cards.why: The mother has a sixth and the daughter a half: that is 1 to 3. The rest is given back in the same ratio, so the mother gets a quarter (200) and the daughter three quarters (600).

cards.ask: Hala dies, leaving her husband and a daughter, and 800 dirhams. There is no 'asaba. What does each get?
cards.source: إلا على الزوجين
cards.why: The husband takes his quarter (200) only, because nothing is given back to a spouse. The daughter takes her half and the rest is given back to her: 600.

cards.title: Killing, religion and leaving Islam
cards.ar: ولا يرث القاتل من المقتول والكفر كله ملة واحدة يتوارث به أهله ولا يرث المسلم من الكافر ولا الكافر من المسلم ومال المرتد لورثته من المسلمين وما اكتسبه في حال ردته فيء
cards.en: The killer does not inherit from the one he killed. All kinds of kufr (unbelief) count as one religion, so non-Muslims inherit from each other. A Muslim and a non-Muslim do not inherit from each other. A murtadd's wealth goes to his Muslim heirs, but what he earned after leaving Islam is fay' (public wealth).

cards.ask: A Jewish man dies. His only son is a Christian. Does the son inherit?
options: Yes: all kufr counts as one religion
No: they are of two religions
cards.source: والكفر كله ملة واحدة يتوارث به أهله
cards.why: All kinds of unbelief count as one religion for inheritance, so they inherit from each other.

cards.title: When no one knows who died first
cards.ar: وإذا غرق جماعة أو سقط عليهم حائط فلم يعلم من مات
cards.en: If a group drown, or a wall falls on them, and no one knows who died first, each one's wealth goes to his own living heirs. They do not inherit from each other.

cards.ask: Two brothers, Adam and Idris, drown together in a flood. No one knows who died first. Does either inherit from the other?
options: No: each one's wealth goes to his own heirs
Yes: the older one inherits from the younger
cards.source: فمال كل واحد منهم للأحياء من ورثته
cards.why: When the order of death is not known, each one's wealth goes to his living heirs only.

cards.title: Two links in one person
cards.ar: وإذا اجتمع في المجوسي قرابتان لو تفرقت في شخصين ورث أحدهما مع الآخر ورث بهما ولا يرث المجوسي بالأنكحة الفاسدة التي يستحلونها في دينهم
cards.en: A Majusi is a fire-worshipper. If one Majusi person is related to the dead in two ways, and two separate people with those two links would both inherit, he inherits by both links. But a Majusi does not inherit through invalid marriages that their religion allows.

cards.title: A child with no father's line
cards.ar: وعصبة ولد الزنا وولد الملاعنة مولى أمهما
cards.en: For a child born outside marriage, or a child of li'an (when the husband denied the child by a sworn process before a judge), their 'asaba is their mother's mawla (her freer, in al-Quduri's time).

cards.ask: In al-Quduri's time: a child of li'an dies with no children of his own. Who is his 'asaba?
cards.source: وعصبة ولد الزنا وولد الملاعنة مولى أمهما
cards.why: The book makes the mother's mawla the 'asaba of a child of li'an or a child born outside marriage.

cards.title: An unborn heir
cards.ar: ومن مات وترك حملا وقف ماله حتى تضع امرأته حملها في قول أبي حنيفة
cards.en: If a man dies and his wife is pregnant, Abu Hanifa says his wealth is held back until she gives birth.

cards.ask: Harun dies while his wife is pregnant. His brothers want to divide the estate now. What does Abu Hanifa say?
options: Hold it until the baby is born
Divide it now among those alive
Divide it now, and the baby gets nothing
cards.source: وقف ماله حتى تضع امرأته حملها في قول أبي حنيفة
cards.why: For Abu Hanifa, the wealth is held back until the wife gives birth.

cards.ask: Which are true of radd and who cannot inherit?

options.text: Nothing is given back (radd) to a husband or wife
A Muslim does not inherit from a non-Muslim relative
What a murtadd owned as a Muslim goes to his Muslim heirs
What a murtadd earned after leaving Islam goes to his heirs
People who drown together inherit from each other

source: إلا على الزوجين
ولا يرث المسلم من الكافر
ومال المرتد لورثته من المسلمين
وما اكتسبه في حال ردته فيء
فمال كل واحد منهم للأحياء من ورثته
cards.why: No radd to spouses, no inheriting across Islam and kufr, and a murtadd's earlier wealth goes to his Muslim heirs. What he earned after is fay', and the drowned do not inherit from each other.

lessons.title: Grandparents, distant relatives and the freer

cards.title: The grandfather and the brothers
cards.ar: والجد أولى بالميراث من الإخوة عند أبي حنيفة
cards.en: Abu Hanifa says the grandfather comes before the brothers, so they get nothing with him. Note: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad say he shares with them, unless sharing would give him less than a third.

cards.title: The grandmothers
cards.ar: وإذا اجتمعت الجدات فالسدس لأقربهن ويحجب الجد أمه ولا ترث أم أبي الأم بسهم وكل جدة تحجب أمها
cards.en: When there are several grandmothers, the sixth goes to the nearest one. The grandfather blocks his own mother. The mother of the mother's father does not get a fixed share. And every grandmother blocks her own mother.

cards.ask: Hiba dies, leaving her mother's mother and her father's father's mother (no mother or father). Who takes the grandmothers' sixth?
options: The mother's mother: she is nearer
cards.source: وإذا اجتمعت الجدات فالسدس لأقربهن
cards.why: The mother's mother is one step away, the other is two. The sixth goes to the nearest.

cards.title: Dhawu al-arham
cards.ar: باب ذوي الأرحام وإذا لم يكن للميت عصبة ولا ذو سهم ورثه ذوو أرحامه وهم عشرة: ولد البنت وولد الأخت وابنة الأخ وابنة العم والخال والخالة وأب الأم والعم من الأم والعمة وولد الأخ من الأم ومن أدلى بهم
cards.en: Dhawu al-arham are other blood relatives. They inherit when there is no 'asaba and no one with a fixed share. They are ten: the daughter's children, the sister's children, the brother's daughter, the 'amm's daughter, the khal, the khala, the mother's father, the 'amm through the mother, the 'amma (father's sister), the maternal half-brother's children, and those related through them.

cards.ask: How many kinds of dhawu al-arham does the book name?
cards.source: ورثه ذوو أرحامه وهم عشرة
cards.why: The book says they are ten, and those related through them.

cards.ask: Which of these are among the dhawu al-arham?

options.text: The daughter's children
The son's daughter
The khal
The 'amma (father's sister)
The father's father
The mother's father

source: وهم عشرة: ولد البنت وولد الأخت وابنة الأخ وابنة العم والخال والخالة وأب الأم والعم من الأم والعمة
الابن وابن الابن وإن سفل والأب والجد أب الأب
البنت وبنت الابن
cards.why: The daughter's children, the khal, the 'amma and the mother's father are among the ten. The son's daughter and the father's father are agreed heirs, not dhawu al-arham.

cards.ask: Ayyub dies. He has no 'asaba and no one with a fixed share. His only relative is his khala. What happens?
options: She inherits, as one of the dhawu al-arham
Nothing: she is not one of the seven women
cards.source: وإذا لم يكن للميت عصبة ولا ذو سهم ورثه ذوو أرحامه
cards.why: With no 'asaba and no share-holder, the dhawu al-arham inherit, and the khala is one of them.

cards.title: Which of them first
cards.ar: وأولاهم ولد الميت ثم ولد الأبوين أو أحدهما وهم بنات الإخوة وولد الأخوات ثم ولد أبوي أبويه أو أحدهما وهم الأخوال والخالات والعمات
cards.en: First come the dead person's own descendants (like a daughter's child), then the descendants of his parents (brothers' daughters, sisters' children), then the descendants of his grandparents (khals, khalas and 'ammas).

cards.ask: Hadi has no 'asaba and no share-holder. He leaves his daughter's son and his khal. Who inherits?
cards.source: وأولاهم ولد الميت ثم ولد الأبوين
cards.why: The dead person's own descendants come first, so the daughter's son inherits.

cards.ask: Hadi leaves only his mother's father and his brother's daughter. Who inherits?
cards.source: وإذا استوى ولد أب في درجة فأولاهم من أدلى بوارث وأقربهم أولى من أبعدهم وأب الأم أولى من ولد الأخ والأخت
cards.why: The book says the mother's father comes before the children of a brother or sister.

cards.title: The freer, and a pact of loyalty
cards.ar: والمعتق أحق بالفاضل من سهم ذوي سهام إذا لم تكن عصبة سواه ومولى الموالاة يرث
cards.en: In al-Quduri's time: the man who freed the dead person has the best right to what is left after the fixed shares, if there is no other 'asaba. And the mawla al-muwalat (someone who made a pact of loyalty with the dead person) also inherits.

cards.ask: In al-Quduri's time: a freed woman dies, leaving her daughter and the man who freed her. Who takes what is left after the daughter's half?
cards.source: والمعتق أحق بالفاضل من سهم ذوي سهام إذا لم تكن عصبة
cards.why: The freer has the best right to what is left after the fixed shares, so the daughter takes her half and he takes the other half.

cards.title: The freer's family
cards.ar: وإذا ترك المعتق أبا مولاه وابن مولاه فماله للابن وقال أبو يوسف: للأب السدس والباقي للابن فإن ترك جد مولاه وأخ مولاه فالمال للجد في قول أبي حنيفة
cards.en: If a freed person dies after his freer, leaving the freer's father and son, his wealth goes to the son. Note: Abu Yusuf gives the father a sixth and the son the rest. If he leaves the freer's grandfather and brother, Abu Hanifa gives it to the grandfather. Wala' cannot be sold or given as a gift.

cards.ask: Which are true of grandfathers, distant relatives and wala'?

options.text: Wala' (the freer's tie) cannot be sold or given as a gift
For Abu Hanifa, the grandfather comes before the brothers
Every grandmother blocks her own mother
The khala inherits even when there is a son
The farther grandmother shares the sixth with the nearer

source: ولا يباع الولاء ولا يوهب
والجد أولى بالميراث من الإخوة عند أبي حنيفة
وكل جدة تحجب أمها
وإذا لم يكن للميت عصبة ولا ذو سهم
فالسدس لأقربهن
cards.why: Wala' is not sold or given, the grandfather comes first for Abu Hanifa, and each grandmother blocks her mother. The dhawu al-arham only inherit when there is no 'asaba, and the sixth goes to the nearest grandmother.

lessons.title: Working out the shares: the base number

cards.title: Base 2 and base 3
cards.ar: إذا كان في المسألة نصف ونصف أو نصف وما بقي فأصلها من اثنين وإن كان ثلث وما بقي أو ثلثان وما بقي فأصلها من ثلاثة
cards.en: To work out an inheritance, first find the asl (base number): the smallest number all the shares can be counted in. A half and a half, or a half and the rest: the base is 2. A third and the rest, or two thirds and the rest: the base is 3.

cards.ask: Husna dies with no children, leaving her husband and her brother. What is the base number?
cards.source: أو نصف وما بقي فأصلها من اثنين
cards.why: The husband has a half and the brother the rest: a half and what is left is base 2. One part each.

cards.title: Base 6, and 'awl
cards.ar: وإذا كان سدس وما بقي أو نصف وثلث أو سدس فأصلها من ستة وتعول إلى سبعة وثمانية وتسعة وعشرة
cards.en: A sixth and the rest, or a half with a third or a sixth: the base is 6. It can rise by 'awl to 7, 8, 9 or 10. 'Awl is when the shares add up to more than the whole, so the base is raised and every share shrinks a little.

cards.ask: Ghada dies, leaving her mother and her son. What is the base number?
cards.source: وإذا كان سدس وما بقي
cards.why: The mother has a sixth (there is a child) and the son the rest: a sixth and what is left is base 6.

cards.ask: A woman dies with no children, leaving her husband (a half), her full sister (a half) and her mother (a third). Out of 6, that is 3 + 3 + 2. What does the base rise to?
cards.source: نصف وثلث أو سدس فأصلها من ستة وتعول إلى سبعة وثمانية
cards.why: 3 + 3 + 2 = 8, which is more than 6. So the base rises by 'awl to 8, and each gets their parts out of 8.

cards.title: Base 12
cards.ar: وإن كان مع الربع ثلث أو سدس فأصلها من اثني عشر وتعول إلى ثلاثة عشر وخمسة عشرة وسبعة عشر
cards.en: A quarter with a third or a sixth: the base is 12. It can rise by 'awl to 13, 15 or 17.

cards.ask: Faris dies with no children, leaving his wife (a quarter), his mother (a third) and one brother (the rest). From a base of 12, how many parts does the brother get?
cards.source: وإن كان مع الربع ثلث أو سدس فأصلها من اثني عشر
cards.why: Out of 12, the wife gets 3 and the mother 4. That leaves 5 for the brother.

cards.title: Base 24
cards.ar: وإذا كان مع الثمن ثلثان أو سدس فأصلها من أربعة وعشرين وتعول إلى سبعة وعشرين
cards.en: An eighth with two thirds or a sixth: the base is 24. It can rise by 'awl to 27.

cards.ask: Which base numbers can rise by 'awl?
source: وتعول إلى سبعة وثمانية وتسعة وعشرة
وتعول إلى ثلاثة عشر
وتعول إلى سبعة وعشرين
أو نصف وما بقي فأصلها من اثنين
cards.why: 6 rises to 7, 8, 9 or 10; 12 to 13, 15 or 17; 24 to 27. The book gives no 'awl for 2 or 3.

cards.ask: Sahl dies, leaving his wife (an eighth), two daughters (two thirds) and his father. From 24, how many parts does the father get?
source: وإذا كان مع الثمن ثلثان أو سدس فأصلها من أربعة وعشرين
لكل واحد من الأبوين مع الولد
cards.why: Out of 24, the wife gets 3 and the daughters 16. The father gets a sixth (4) with a child, and as 'asaba he also takes the 1 left over: 5.

cards.ask: Which base number?
items: A sixth and what is left
source: إذا كان في المسألة نصف ونصف أو نصف وما بقي فأصلها من اثنين
وإذا كان سدس وما بقي أو نصف وثلث أو سدس فأصلها من ستة
وإن كان مع الربع ثلث أو سدس فأصلها من اثني عشر
cards.why: Halves with a half or the rest are 2. A sixth and the rest, or a half and a third, are 6. A quarter with a third or a sixth is 12.

lessons.title: When the parts do not divide
lessons.arabic: فإذا انقسمت المسألة على الورثة فقد صحت

cards.title: Making the parts whole
cards.ar: فإذا انقسمت المسألة على الورثة فقد صحت وإن لم تنقسم سهام فريق عليهم فاضرب عددهم في أصل المسألة وعولها إن كانت عائلة فما خرج فمنه تصح المسألة
cards.en: If the parts divide evenly among the heirs, the case is done. If one group's parts do not divide among them, multiply the base (raised by 'awl if it has one) by the number of people in that group. The answer is the number the case comes right from.

cards.title: A wife and two brothers
cards.ar: كامرأة وأخوين: للمرأة الربع سهم وللأخوين ما بقي وهي ثلاثة أسهم لا تنقسم عليهما فاضرب اثنين في أصل المسألة فتكون ثمانية ومنها تصح
cards.en: Example: a wife and two brothers. The wife's quarter is 1 part, and the brothers get the rest, 3 parts. 3 does not divide between 2, so multiply the base by 2. That gives 8, and the case comes right from 8: the wife 2, each brother 3.

cards.ask: Yasin dies with no children, leaving his wife and two brothers, and 800 dirhams. The case comes right from 8. What does each brother get?
cards.source: فاضرب اثنين في أصل المسألة فتكون ثمانية ومنها تصح
cards.why: Out of 8, the wife has 2 and each brother 3. Each part is 100, so each brother gets 300.

cards.title: When the numbers agree
cards.ar: وإن وافق سهامهم عددهم فاضرب وفق عددهم في أصل المسألة كامرأة وستة إخوة للمرأة الربع سهم وللإخوة ثلاثة فاضرب وفق عددهم في أصل المسألة يكون ثمانية ومنه تصح
cards.en: If the group's parts and their number share a common factor, multiply the base by the wafq (their number divided by that factor). Example: a wife and six brothers. The wife has 1 part, the brothers 3. 3 and 6 share 3, so the wafq of 6 is 2. Multiply 4 by 2: the case comes right from 8.

cards.ask: A wife and six brothers: the case comes right from 8, and the wife has 2. How many parts does each brother get?
cards.source: فاضرب وفق عددهم في أصل المسألة يكون ثمانية ومنه تصح
cards.why: The brothers share 6 parts of 8, so each has 1.

cards.title: Two groups or more
cards.ar: وإن لم تنقسم سهام فريقين أو أكثر فاضرب أحد الفريقين
cards.en: If two or more groups' parts do not divide, multiply one group's number by the other, then the result by any third group, then the result by the base.

cards.title: When the groups are the same size
cards.ar: فإن تساوت الأعداد أجزأ أحدهما عن الآخر كامرأتين وأخوين فاضرب اثنين
cards.en: If the groups have the same number, one of them is enough. Example: two wives and two brothers: multiply the base by 2.

cards.ask: Two wives and two brothers, no children. The base is 4. What does the case come right from?
cards.source: كامرأتين وأخوين فاضرب اثنين في أصل المسألة
cards.why: Both groups are 2, so one 2 is enough: 4 times 2 is 8. The wives get 1 each, the brothers 3 each.

cards.title: When one number fits in the other
cards.ar: فإن كان أحد العددين جزءا من الآخر أغنى الأكثر عن الأقل كأربع نسوة وأخوين إذا ضربت الأربعة أجزأك عن الآخر
cards.en: If one group's number fits inside the other, the bigger one is enough. Example: four wives and two brothers: multiplying by 4 covers the 2 as well.

cards.ask: Four wives and two brothers, no children. The base is 4. What does the case come right from?
cards.source: كأربع نسوة وأخوين إذا ضربت الأربعة أجزأك عن الآخر
cards.why: 2 fits inside 4, so multiply only by 4: 4 times 4 is 16. Each wife gets 1, each brother 6.

cards.title: When the two numbers agree
cards.ar: فإن وافق أحد العددين الآخر ضربت وفق أحدهما في جميع الآخر ثم ما اجتمع في أصل المسألة كأربع نسوة وأخت وستة أعمام فالستة توافق الأربعة بالنصف فاضرب نصف أحدهما في جميع الآخر ثم ما اجتمع في أصل المسألة تكون ثمانية وأربعين ومنها تصح
cards.en: If the two numbers share a factor, multiply the wafq of one by the whole of the other, then by the base. Example: four wives, a sister and six 'amms. 6 and 4 share a half, so multiply 2 by 6 to get 12, then by the base 4: the case comes right from 48.

cards.ask: In that case of 48, the wives have a quarter (12), the sister a half (24) and the six 'amms the rest. How many parts does each 'amm get?
cards.source: تكون ثمانية وأربعين ومنها تصح
cards.why: 48 minus 12 minus 24 leaves 12 for the 'amms. Shared by six, that is 2 each.

lessons.title: Paying out the estate, and a second death
lessons.arabic: فإذا صحت المسألة فاضرب سهام كل وارث في التركة

cards.title: Turning parts into money
cards.ar: فإذا صحت المسألة فاضرب سهام كل وارث في التركة ثم اقسم ما اجتمع على ما صحت منه الفريضة يخرج حق ذلك الوارث
cards.en: Once the case comes right, multiply each heir's parts by the tarika (the estate), then divide by the number the case came right from. That gives what the heir is owed.

cards.ask: A wife and two brothers: the case comes right from 8, and the wife has 2 parts. The estate is 1,600 dirhams. What does the wife get?
cards.source: فاضرب سهام كل وارث في التركة ثم اقسم ما اجتمع على ما صحت منه الفريضة
cards.why: 2 times 1,600 is 3,200. Divided by 8, that is 400.

cards.ask: Wife, mother and brother: the case comes right from 12, and the mother has 4 parts. The estate is 2,400 dirhams. What does the mother get?
cards.source: يخرج حق ذلك الوارث
cards.why: 4 times 2,400 is 9,600. Divided by 12, that is 800.

cards.title: A second death before dividing
cards.ar: وإذا لم تقسم التركة حتى مات أحد الورثة فإن كان ما يصيبه من الميت الأول ينقسم على ورثته فقد صحت المسألتان مما صحت الأولى
cards.en: Munasakha is when one of the heirs dies before the estate was divided. If his parts from the first estate divide evenly among his own heirs, both cases come right from the first case's number.

cards.ask: Ali dies, leaving two sons: base 2, one part each. Before dividing, his son Hasan dies, leaving only one son. What do both cases come right from?
cards.source: فإن كان ما يصيبه من الميت الأول ينقسم على ورثته فقد صحت المسألتان مما صحت الأولى
cards.why: Hasan's 1 part goes whole to his one son, so it divides, and both cases come right from 2.

cards.title: If it does not divide
cards.ar: وإن لم ينقسم صححت فريضة الميت الثاني بالطريقة التي ذكرناها ثم ضربت إحدى المسألتين في الأخرى إن لم يكن بين سهام الميت الثاني وما صحت منه فريضة موافقة
cards.en: If it does not divide, work out the second dead person's case the same way. Then, if his parts and his own case's number share no common factor, multiply one case's number by the other.

cards.ask: Ali dies, leaving two sons: base 2. Before dividing, his son Hasan dies, leaving three sons (base 3). Hasan's 1 part does not divide by 3, and 1 and 3 share no factor. What do both cases come right from?
cards.source: ثم ضربت إحدى المسألتين في الأخرى
cards.why: Multiply one case by the other: 2 times 3 is 6. The living son gets 3, and Hasan's three sons 1 each.

cards.title: If they share a factor
cards.ar: فإن كان بينهما موافقة فاضرب المسألة الثانية في الأولى فما اجتمع صحت منه المسألتان
cards.en: If they do share a common factor, the book says to multiply the second case into the first (using its wafq), and both cases come right from the result.

cards.title: Each heir's parts
cards.ar: وكل من له شيء من المسألة الأولى مضروب في وفق المسألة الثانية ومن كان له شيء من المسألة الثانية مضروب في وفق تركة الميت الثاني
cards.en: Each heir's parts in the first case are multiplied by the wafq of the second case. Each heir's parts in the second case are multiplied by the wafq of the second dead person's share.

cards.ask: In a second-death case where the numbers share a factor, what is each first-case heir's parts multiplied by?
options: The wafq of the second case
cards.source: وكل من له شيء من المسألة الأولى مضروب في وفق المسألة الثانية
cards.why: The book says each heir of the first case has his parts multiplied by the wafq of the second case.

cards.title: Down to the grains of a dirham
cards.ar: وإذا صحت مسألة المناسخة وأردت معرفة ما يصيب كل واحد من حبات الدرهم قسمت ما صحت منه المسألة على ثمانية وأربعين فما خرج أخذت له من سهام كل وارث
cards.en: To know what each heir gets in habbas (grains, small weights of a dirham), divide the number the case came right from by 48, and count each heir's parts by the result.

cards.ask: Put the steps of working out an inheritance in order.
steps: Find the base from the shares (2, 3, 6, 12 or 24)
Raise it by 'awl if the shares are too many
Multiply by a group's number (or its wafq) if their parts do not divide
Multiply each heir's parts by the estate and divide by the final number
source: فأصلها من ستة وتعول إلى سبعة
فاضرب عددهم في أصل المسألة وعولها إن كانت عائلة
فاضرب سهام كل وارث في التركة ثم اقسم ما اجتمع على ما صحت منه الفريضة
cards.why: First the base, then 'awl, then correcting for groups that do not divide, and last turning the parts into money.
